jobs.title: Project Coordinator IV (Sustainability)
jobs.description:
**Position Description:**  
The Project Coordinator IV – Sustainability provides project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to the BuildLACCD Sustainability Strike Team throughout the planning, scoping, design, procurement, construction, commissioning, and closeout of sustainability and energy-related capital improvement projects across the Los Angeles Community College District (LACCD).  
  
Working under the direction of the Sustainability Strike Team Lead, this position supports the Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers and coordinates with District personnel, Campus Administration, College Project Teams (CPTs), Program Management Office (PMO), Program Controls, and other stakeholders to support project budget development, funding verification, cost forecasting, financial reporting, and project establishment.  
  
The position supports Districtwide sustainability initiatives, including Energy Information Systems (EIS), Sustainability and Climate Action Roadmap, Building Management Systems (BMS), Central Plant and Local Building Decarbonization, Central Plant optimization, LED lighting upgrades, energy efficiency retrofits, renewable energy systems, Photovoltaic (PV), microgrids, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS), electric vehicle (EV) charging infrastructure, electrification, and other sustainability-related capital improvement projects.  
  

* Provide day-to-day project coordination, cost management, and financial controls support to Strike Team Cost Analyst, Project Managers, and the Sustainability Strike Team throughout the project lifecycle.
* Prepare, organize, and maintain project management documents, records, correspondence, reports, and other project-related communications.
* Support project establishment and White Paper development by coordinating financial documentation, funding verification, preliminary budgets, cost estimates, and required reviews in accordance with established BuildLACCD PMO Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Coordinate with District personnel, CPTs, PMO, Program Controls, and other stakeholders to verify project budgets, available funding, cost estimates, forecasts, and financial requirements.
* Coordinate with CPTs and PMO Cost Analysts to support budget establishment, monitoring, budget transfers, and accurate financial reporting.
* Develop and maintain cost forecasts and Estimates-to-Complete (ETCs); track Change Order Requests (CORs), commitments, and funding availability.
* Monitor project budgets, expenditures, contract balances, remaining encumbrances, funding availability, and financial risks to identify potential shortfalls before they affect project delivery.
* Work with PMO Cost Analysts to verify the accuracy and integrity of project budgets and financial forecasts in accordance with established cost management procedures.
* Participate in change management and risk assessment meetings to identify cost-related trends, risks, exposures, and potential mitigation strategies.
* Perform monthly budget and cost reconciliations to support accurate month-end reporting and review expenditures across multiple funding sources.
* Coordinate with scheduling teams to assess cash flow and schedule performance impacts on costs, including variances, overruns, underruns, and forecasting concerns.
* Review financial reports, cost performance, and progress data; communicate material variances and potential financial risks to Project Managers and appropriate stakeholders.
* Track contract Periods of Performance (POP), contract balances, remaining encumbrances, and available funding.
* Coordinate invoice oversight and reconciliation with accounting and project stakeholders to support timely and accurate payment processing.
* Collaborate with PMO to validate project budget data, support stakeholder dashboards, and maintain accurate program controls databases and financial reports.
* Gather physical completion data and coordinate updates to project budget and forecast records as appropriate.
* Proactively identify funding issues that could delay procurement, contract execution, project initiation, or other critical activities.
* Support compliance with applicable District requirements, BuildLACCD PMO SOPs, cost management procedures, and bond funding requirements throughout project development and implementation.
* Perform other bond-eligible project cost management and coordination duties as directed by the Sustainability Strike Team Lead.

  
**Minimum Required Qualifications:**  

* Minimum of five (5) years of recent professional experience in engineering, project management, sustainability, project controls, cost management, and/or a related field.
* BS/BA degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Sustainability, or a related field. Four additional years of qualifying experience beyond the minimum experience requirement may be substituted for the required education.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including complex formulas, pivot tables, data analysis, financial modeling, budget tracking, and reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, including Word, Outlook, and PowerPoint.
* Proficiency with enterprise-level Project Management Information Systems (PMIS), such as Proliance, Trimble Unity, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong writing, analytical, organizational, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, coordinate with diverse stakeholders, and manage multiple project priorities.

  
**Preferred Qualifications:**  

* Experience supporting capital improvement projects within large public works or educational facility construction programs.
* Experience with project cost management, forecasting, Estimate-to-Complete (ETC) development, and funding verification.
* Familiarity with BuildLACCD or similar capital improvement program financial controls, budget management, and project establishment processes.

jobs.description:
Reporting to the Director of Student and Alumni Programs of the UCLA Ziman Institute for Real Estate and Urban Economics (ZI), the Program and Operations Coordinator will be responsible for coordinating and supporting the execution of the Ziman Institute's major programs and events as well as marketing, course support, and general office operations. Major duties for this position will include: major event coordination and data management support for Ziman-supported student programs (Anderson, Undergrad, Law) and outreach programs (Levine Programs, Housing as Health Care, and Research); Faculty and course support for Ziman UCLA Anderson real estate curriculum courses; digital marketing including website editorial management and maintenance, social media management, and Ziman partner marketing requests; business transaction support, including processing non-employee reimbursements and serving as purchasing system back-up; office management; and administrative support to the Ziman Institute's Faculty Director. Programs and events will primarily be on-campus, however this may also include coordination of off-site events. Members of the Ziman Institute team assign short and long-term tasks on a daily basis. The incumbent must be able to independently prioritize tasks, plan, monitor progress and check quality; apply working knowledge of University policy and procedures; and exhaust creativity and resourcefulness to fulfill assignments as instructed. Independent interpretation, anticipation and problem-solving are required. * Demonstrated high level of analytical and creative problem-solving skills, highly efficient and organized. (Required)

jobs.title: Dolby Creator Lab Program Coordinator (Contract)
jobs.description:
Job description

Company and benefits

Social Impact & Sustainability

Job ID

41800

Join the leader in entertainment innovation and help us design the future. At Dolby, science meets art, and high tech means more than computer code. As a member of the Dolby team, you’ll see and hear the results of your work everywhere, from movie theaters to smartphones. We continue to revolutionize how people create, deliver, and enjoy entertainment worldwide. To do that, we need the absolute best talent. We’re big enough to give you all the resources you need, and small enough so you can make a real difference and earn recognition for your work. We offer a collegial culture, challenging projects, and excellent compensation and benefits, not to mention a **Flex Work** approach that is truly flexible to support where, when, and how you do your best work.

The **Marketing** department creates passion and relevance for the "Dolby Difference" driving sell-in and sell-thru of Dolby enabled devices, services, content, and experiences across multiple constituents – partners, creators, consumers, and developers.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for a Program Coordinator (Contract) to join our Dolby Creator Lab team, our initiative to help creatives advance the art of storytelling. The mission of the Dolby Creator Lab is to inspire and educate the next generation of content creators to bring their dreams to life, in Dolby. Our core values are to enable, inspire, educate, and amplify human stories from new voices that need to be heard.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Support Dolby Creator Lab initiatives, including our weekly podcast, music and UGC programs, virtual and in-person events, grant programs, and partnerships.
* Responsibilities include scheduling podcast recording sessions across all categories, including film/tv, music, and gaming (including direct interface with important external business partners and internal stakeholders), managing digital assets, reviewing edits, writing program descriptions, and tracking all deliverables with Social, Digital, and external partners.
* Work cross-functionally with internal teams including Design, Copy, Social, PR, and Digital to develop, schedule, and release Creator Lab content across Dolby’s global channels, and with our external partners and vendors, supporting ongoing collaborations and project tracking.
* Coordinate and manage digital content for Creator Lab’s Dolby.com presence. Build and publish net new pages, and working with the digital team to roll out new features and functions.
* Prepare and coordinate internal and external communications, including newsletters, employee giveaways, presentation decks on Creator Lab initiatives and programs.
* Support the Sr. Manager of Programs and Content and Dolby Creator Lab Director with vendor, partner, and sponsorship contracting, onboarding, invoicing, expense reporting, and travel.
* Support the Sr. Manager of Programs and Content and Dolby Creator Lab Director on research projects related to program initiatives.
* Upcoming and always on initiatives and programs include but are not limited to Dolby Creator Talks Podcast, Dolby Creator Lab Grants, Film Festivals (Sundance, SXSW), CES, Dolby Creator Lab Short Film Program.

**Qualifications**
------------------

* Strong written and verbal communications skills.
* Poise and comfort level with speaking to all levels of staff and management.
* Interest in consumer technology and/or the entertainment industry, including movies, music, and games.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Passionate, positive, and solution-oriented attitude.
* Photoshop, Excel, Word, Outlook, Smartsheet, Keynote, PowerPoint, Teams, and Slack proficiency.
* Ability to track projects and deliverables in Miro and Airtable. Familiarity with content management systems. (training available)
* Experience with in-person and virtual event support and production (video and photo shoots, film screenings, receptions, conferences and festivals).

**Duration**
------------

* 6 months

The hourly rate range for this position in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and the New York area is $50–$58/hour and may vary outside these locations. Our ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, competencies, experience, market demands, internal parity, and relevant education or training. Your recruiter can share more about the specific range during the hiring process.

*Dolby will consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of San Francisco Police Code, Article 49, and Administrative Code, Article 12*

**Equal Employment Opportunity:**
  
Dolby is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Our success depends on the combined skills and talents of all our employees. We are committed to making employment decisions without regard to race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, marital status, family status, medical condition, disability, military service, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions or any other classification protected by federal, state, and local laws and ordinances.

jobs.title: Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Program Coordinator**

**Latecoere Interconnection Systems**  
**Location**: Los Alamitos, CA  
**Department**: Program Management  
**Reports To**: Program Manager

**Introduction to Latecoere**  
Tier 1 to the world’s leading industry manufacturers, Latecoere serves aerospace with innovative solutions for a sustainable world. The Group operates in all segments of the aerospace industry (commercial, regional, business, defense and space) in two business areas: Aerostructures (doors, fuselage, wings and empennage, struts & rods) and Interconnection Systems (wiring, avionic racks, onboard equipment, electronic systems).

**Position Summary**

Latecoere Interconnection Systems is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Program Coordinator to support the execution of aerospace and defense programs. Reporting directly to the Program Manager, this role is responsible for coordinating program activities, maintaining schedules and documentation, tracking deliverables, and facilitating communication across departments to ensure customer commitments are met on time and within scope.

The ideal candidate thrives in a fast-paced manufacturing environment, enjoys working cross-functionally, and possesses strong project coordination and communication skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the Program Manager in the planning, coordination, and execution of customer programs.
* Maintain program schedules, milestone trackers, action item logs, and status reports.
* Coordinate activities among Engineering, Operations, Quality, Supply Chain, Production, and Finance teams.
* Schedule and facilitate internal meetings, customer reviews, and program status meetings.
* Prepare agendas, presentation materials, meeting minutes, and follow-up actions.
* Monitor program progress and proactively identify scheduling concerns, risks, and open issues.
* Track and maintain customer purchase orders, program documentation, and change requests.
* Assist with new product introduction (NPI) activities and program launches.
* Support engineering change implementation and customer-driven program changes.
* Compile program metrics and prepare reports for management and customer reviews.
* Communicate delivery performance, schedules, and project status to customers through regular status meetings.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to ensure commitments and deliverables are completed on time.
* Assist in the development and implementation of process improvements that enhance program execution and customer satisfaction.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Associate degree in Business, Project Management, Engineering, Supply Chain, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Two or more years of experience in project coordination, program coordination, customer service, production planning, supply chain, or a related role.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams.
* Strong attention to detail and problem-solving abilities.

**Preferred**

* Bachelor's degree in a related field.
* Experience in aerospace, defense, manufacturing, or other highly regulated industries.
* Familiarity with project management principles and scheduling tools.
* Knowledge of AS9100 quality standards and aerospace manufacturing processes.

**What You'll Bring**

* A customer-focused mindset.
* Strong organizational and follow-through skills.
* Ability to build effective working relationships across all levels of the organization.
* A proactive and collaborative approach to problem-solving.
* Ability to work independently while supporting team objectives.

**Physical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based with regular interaction on the manufacturing floor.
* Ability to sit, stand, walk, and use a computer for extended periods.
* Ability to occasionally lift up to 20 pounds.

**Compensation**

* $30.00 - $40.00 per hour

(Actual compensation will be based on experience, qualifications, education, skills, and business needs.)

**Why Join Latecoere?**

Join a global aerospace leader and play an integral role in supporting programs that help connect and power the world's leading aircraft platforms. At Latecoere, you'll work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment focused on innovation, quality, and continuous improvement.

Latecoere is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace for all employees.

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Experience:

* Program Coordination: 1 year (Preferred)
* Manufacturing: 1 year (Preferred)

Ability to Commute:

* Los Alamitos, CA 90720 (Required)

jobs.description:
HealthFitness, a Trustmark company, is a proven leader in providing fitness solutions that engage and connect people both on-site and online, to create a strong community of health. Our work focuses on creating meaningful connections with each of our participants to help them move forward. We foster each individual’s journey by creating communities of health within the organizations we serve – so that everyone is supported. As an employee of HealthFitness you will enjoy a variety of health and financial benefits and receive competitive pay. We provide personal and professional support, training and development and flexible employment opportunities.

**About the role**

Bring your energy to a role where you can shape meaningful experiences every day. HealthFitness is hiring a **Fitness Program Coordinator** in **Torrance, CA**.

What you'll do:

**Create and launch engaging wellness programs** that motivate participants and elevate overall health and fitness outcomes.

**Plan, coordinate, market, and execute events and initiatives** designed to maximize participation and member engagement.

**Lead and support dynamic teams**, ensuring staff are trained, empowered, and equipped to deliver exceptional experiences.

**Monitor program quality and measure success** by tracking participation, outcomes, and overall program effectiveness.

️ **Bring wellness to life** through hands-on delivery, including group exercise instruction, personal training, fitness assessments, exercise prescriptions, and new member orientations.

**Champion a best-in-class fitness environment** by providing facility oversight, supporting daily operations, and creating positive member experiences.

Monday–Friday

Comprehensive benefits package  
Free continuing education credits  
PTO + paid holidays + volunteer paid time off

* Computer proficiency in Microsoft Office programs including at minimum Word, Excel, and Outlook.

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
We're based on over 15 years of success, producing world-class video content and building, developing, and managing a number of high-traffic websites. Our award-winning content and websites are created exclusively by us and directly for the use of millions of users worldwide. At Kodify, we're not just pushing boundaries in online entertainment—we're rewriting the script! Our goal is to empower our people with everything they need to pioneer innovation in our industry. Our culture is our secret sauce, and we're committed to preserving and enhancing it every step of the way.

Join our crew, where the Kodify team is not just an asset—it's our crown jewel. We prioritize their growth and well-being above all else, ensuring they're set up for success and always inspired to deliver their best work.

As a rapidly expanding company with diverse hubs across the globe and over 20 vibrant national cultures, working with us means embracing thrilling challenges tailor-made for a star Production Coordinator!

**YOUR ROLE:**

We are seeking an experienced and highly organized Production Coordinator to join our team. Reporting to the Senior Line Producer, the Production Coordinator will support all day-to-day production operations, special projects and overall workflow within the production office. They serve as the central communication hub between departments, managing logistics, paperwork, schedules and resources throughout all stages of production – from pre-production through delivery.

Our ideal candidate has an innate passion for TV/film production, thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and is proactive, solution-oriented and exceptionally detail-focused. In tandem with the Senior Line Producer, key responsibilities include booking and maintaining the crew schedule for all productions, overseeing the daily workflow of full-time Production Assistants, maintaining production management software applications and assisting with onboarding and training new hires within the department.

The Production Coordinator must also effectively communicate status updates on production plans, schedules, budgets and any changes to the Senior Line Producer and production teams to ensure alignment and smooth execution. This role requires excellent

organizational skills, strong communication skills, and strategic problem-solving.

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Serve as the primary liaison for all production operations between the Senior Line Producer, Production Manager, and production departments.
* Book and manage crew scheduling.
* Approve crew invoices.
* Oversee full-time Production Assistants’ scheduling, communications and workflow.
* Provide administrative support (meeting scheduling, distributing call sheets, schedules, COIs, crew paperwork, talent paperwork, etc.).
* Liaise closely with Senior Line Producer for crew allocation, tracking production budgets and cost reporting.
* Assist with talent coordination (testing, payments, call sheets, script distribution, paperwork, etc.).
* Manage production software, calendars, spreadsheets and distribute reference materials (e.g. scripts).
* Maintain receipts, reconcile credit card logs, and assist with departmental purchasing.
* Collaborate with the Location Coordinator to manage aspects of shoot location(s): attend scouts, facilitate contracts and insurance, and oversee the planning and execution of load-in and load-out logistics.
* Liaise with vendors and suppliers for equipment rentals, catering and other logistical needs.
* Support the Senior Line Producer and Production Manager on set when needed.
* Assist in onboarding and training new production department hires.
* Anticipate operational needs, troubleshoot issues, and uphold positive crew relations.

**Requirements**

* 3-5 years of relevant TV/film production experience.
* Robust project management skills and proficiency with production, scheduling and budgeting tools (G-Suite, Smartsheet, AirTable, Studio Binder, etc.).
* Strong knowledge of production workflows, scheduling and budgeting.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and writing skills with the ability to multitask and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong critical thinking skills.
* Confident Interpersonal skills.
* Proactive problem solver with a positive, adaptable attitude.
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism at all times.
* Intermediate knowledge of production equipment and talent wrangling is a plus.

**WHAT WE OFFER:**

* Generous training and development budget (10% of you annual salary)
* Competitive salary
* Generous PTO
* 1 month paid sabbatical after 3 years with us!
* 1 day off on your Birthday
* Extended parental leave
* Health and Wellness Budget
* Health insurance
* Cool and modern office space
* Latest tech equipment
* Healthy snacks and drinks provided at all times
* Opportunity to travel internationally in Company retreats!

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000.00 - $75,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Clergy Administrative Coordinator
jobs.description:

**About the Role**

Behind every well-organized department is someone who knows how to connect the details, anticipate what's needed, and keep important priorities moving. As the Administrative Coordinator at Southland Credit Union, you'll provide high-level administrative and operational support to our SVP of People & Culture while helping coordinate the projects, communications, and initiatives that support the broader department.

This role combines executive-level administrative support with presentation development, communications, and project coordination. You'll help manage priorities, prepare materials for leadership discussions, organize departmental activities, and ensure important follow-ups don't get lost. Your ability to exercise sound judgment, work independently, and bring structure to complex details will make you an important resource to the People & Culture team.

  
Major Duties and Responsibilities:

**Supporting Leadership and Keeping Priorities Moving**

You'll work closely with the SVP of People & Culture to manage schedules, coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, organize leadership materials, and ensure discussions and follow-up items stay on track. You'll also draft and format correspondence, reports, and professional documents while maintaining organized departmental records and resources.

Being effective in this role means knowing how to look ahead. You'll anticipate administrative needs, navigate scheduling conflicts, manage competing priorities, and use good judgment when handling sensitive employee and organizational information. From coordinating appointments to tracking outstanding assignments, your organization and follow-through will help keep departmental priorities moving.

**Turning Information Into Clear, Professional Communications**

You'll use your organizational and creative skills to develop polished, executive-ready presentations, reports, and supporting materials for leadership discussions, departmental meetings, employee training, and organizational initiatives. You'll maintain project timelines, trackers, and status updates, follow up on outstanding deliverables, and coordinate logistics, communications, and materials for employee engagement programs, training sessions, recognition activities, and organizational events.

You'll also support the ongoing work of the department by helping prepare and maintain HR policies, procedures, forms, and resources. Compiling information, conducting research, and preparing reports will give the team additional support for planning and decision-making. You'll also assist with administrative responsibilities such as invoice processing, expense reports, purchasing, and budget tracking.

Success in this role means leadership has the organization and support needed to stay focused on priorities, departmental initiatives remain coordinated, and communications and materials are accurate and professionally prepared. We seek a reliable and compassionate CHW to provide CHW and ECM services and conduct consistent Community Outreach to clients in the community. As a CHW, you will play a vital role in improving the health and well-being of individuals.

You will work closely with patients, families, and healthcare providers to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care that addresses the physical, emotional, and social needs of our clients. This position will assist in connecting individuals with health and community support services, playing a crucial role in helping people access the care and resources they need directly. The role involves providing CHW or ECM Services on the spot and conducting outbound calls to connect clients to resources.

**Responsibilities:**

**CHW/ ECM Services:**

1. Conduct patient assessments to identify health and social needs.

2. Develop personalized care plans in collaboration with patients, families, and healthcare providers.

3. Provide education and support on chronic disease management, healthy behaviors, and self-care.

4. Facilitate access to community resources, services, and referrals.

5. Coordinate care transitions and communicate with healthcare providers.

6. Conduct regular home visits and phone follow-ups to monitor progress and ensure ongoing support.

7. Document patient interactions and care plans in the electronic health record within 24 hours, and close all encounters.

8. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to address patient needs and improve health outcomes.

9. Identify and address social determinants of health and health disparities.

10. Provide cultural competency and linguistically appropriate services.

11. Maintain patient confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA guidelines.

12. CHW minimum productivity is expected to be 80% clinical (patient billable encounters) and 20% Non-productive (driving/documentation/outreach, etc.).

13. Schedule 75% of clients before the 15th of each month.

14. Conduct outreach for community awareness of the ECM program.

15. Attend regular staff meetings, training sessions, and other meetings as requested.

16. Minimum caseload of 25-30 ECM clients, and may increase during times when the clinic is experiencing a staffing shortage.

17. Minimum combined total of 20 CHW and ECM touches per month.

**Community Outreach:**

1. Initially, outbound calls will be made to individuals on the assigned referral lists to educate them regarding CHW and ECM services available to them under their health plan.

a. Insurance must be verified before services can be provided to ensure the client is eligible.

b. If the client’s need is minimal and can be addressed in the short term, a CHW touch will be conducted on the spot, such as providing resources or navigating a website.

c. If the client’s need is extensive and requires a long-term plan to achieve their goals, an ECM intake/successful engagement will be conducted on the spot.

2. Engage members in a respectful, culturally sensitive, and trauma-informed manner.

3. Accurately document outreach activity using standardized tracking systems, designated outreach platforms, and Dr. Cloud.

4. Track member responses, time spent, and follow-up needs in accordance with approved program procedures.

5. Schedule intake appointments and ensure appropriate follow-up to confirm member engagement.

6. Follow internal workflows for outreach outcomes.

7. Confirm appointment attendance and relay updates to care and coordination teams as needed.

8. Identify and escalate issues such as insurance discrepancies, invalid contact information, urgent support needs, or language barriers.

9. Participate in regular team meetings, compliance training, and performance reviews.

3. Certification as a CHW (CCHW) or willingness to obtain within 18 months.

5. Strong communication, interpersonal, and cultural competency skills.

**What you bring**

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager
jobs.description:
The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is responsible for helping customers achieve measurable business outcomes through the successful adoption and ongoing value realization of AvePoint solutions.

As a trusted advisor, you will develop a deep understanding of your customers' business goals, technology environment, and priorities, then translate those needs into actionable success plans. You will partner closely with Sales, Renewals, Technical Support, Services, and other internal teams to drive adoption, identify and mitigate risk, strengthen customer relationships, and position customers for long-term success.

This role is ideal for someone who is customer-obsessed, commercially aware, data-driven, and comfortable navigating both business and technical conversations with stakeholders ranging from administrators to executive leaders.  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own the customer success strategy for an assigned portfolio of customers, developing success plans tied to measurable business objectives, adoption milestones, and customer outcomes.
* Drive product adoption and value realization by helping customers understand, implement, and expand their use of AvePoint solutions.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders at multiple levels, including technical teams, business leaders, and executive sponsors.
* Monitor customer health and engagement, using product adoption, customer sentiment, support history, engagement, and other customer data to identify opportunities and risks.
* Proactively identify and mitigate risk, creating clear action plans for customers showing signs of low adoption, disengagement, or dissatisfaction.
* Conduct Executive Business Reviews and strategic customer conversations that demonstrate realized value, measure progress against customer goals, and establish priorities for the next phase of the relationship.
* Partner with Sales on renewal readiness, ensuring customer value is clearly understood, risks are identified early, and key stakeholders are engaged well ahead of renewal.
* Identify growth and expansion opportunities by understanding evolving customer needs and surfacing qualified opportunities to the appropriate sales teams.
* Maintain accurate customer records and success plans in AvePoint's customer systems, ensuring customer health, activity, risks, opportunities, and next steps are current and actionable.
* Coordinate cross-functional resources across Sales, Support, Services, Product, and other teams to remove customer barriers and drive successful outcomes.
* Develop expertise in AvePoint's platform and solutions, enabling credible conversations about how AvePoint can address customers' evolving governance, security, data management, and technology needs.
* Plan and conduct onsite customer engagements as appropriate to strengthen executive alignment and deepen understanding of customer priorities.

  

**OK, I'm interested… is this the job for me?**

We look for people who value agility, accountability, curiosity, passion, and teamwork. You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy building relationships, solving complex customer challenges, using data to guide decisions, and helping customers turn technology investments into meaningful business outcomes.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor's degree in a relevant field
* 2+ years of experience in a technical consulting role such as technical account management or technical business analysis
* Strong customer satisfaction, customer service, adoption, and retention experience
* Excellent written/verbal communication, organization, presentation, and project management skills
* Ability to work individually and within a highly collaborative global team setting
* Willingness to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment
* Strong experience in communicating with different stakeholders and decision makers, both internally and externally
* Expert at customer relationship management
* Advanced ability to understand business objectives through requirements gathering and analysis
* Impeccable organizational awareness skills

**Knowledge in the following technical areas are a plus:**

* Understanding of Microsoft SharePoint architecture, components, and configuration. Understand the differences between the SharePoint versions and Office 365 collaboration technologies
* Working knowledge of TCP/IP, DHCP, DNS, Active Directory, SMTP, and DHCP technologies
* Working technical knowledge of current software protocols and Internet standards
  

The Salary Range for this role is $83,000 - $125,000. At AvePoint, we strive to offer competitive, fair, and equitable total rewards. The listed salary range represents a good faith estimate, with final offers based on location, experience, skills, and qualifications. The listed range reflects base salary only; our total rewards include base salary, comprehensive benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k) with match, unlimited PTO), and depending on the role, bonuses, commissions, or equity (RSUs). We welcome compensation discussions—apply even if your expectations fall outside the range.

Any personal data you share with us during the application process will be processed strictly in compliance with applicable data protection laws and our Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable, unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.

**The Role**

Valar is hiring across all orgs and the volume keeps climbing. We're looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to carry live searches from week one: scheduling interviews, hosting candidates onsite, managing travel, and keeping Greenhouse accurate across every pipeline in flight. Our coordination team already runs a working process, built for a smaller company than the one we're becoming. You'll step into it, then improve it. Competing calendars, late cancellations, and shifting priorities are the normal condition here, and you'll be trusted to resolve most of it yourself. Candidates meet Valar through you first.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own interview scheduling across teams, time zones, and sites, including the multi-panel days.
* Host candidates onsite and run the day so interviewers and candidates always know where they stand.
* Coordinate candidate travel and review the expenses
* Own Greenhouse data hygiene: stage accuracy, interview kits, scorecard completion, clean candidate records.
* Close the gap between offer accepted and first day: background checks, paperwork, and the handoff to People Operations.
* Resolve scheduling conflicts on your own judgment, bringing recruiters and hiring managers the tradeoff and your recommendation rather than the raw problem.
* Keep pipelines moving with recruiters and hiring managers, flagging stalled candidates and interviewer bottlenecks before a search goes cold.
* Learn what we build and who we hire well enough to answer a candidate's questions yourself.
* Improve the coordination process as you learn it: bring the problem, the proposed fix, then the implementation.
* Pitch in on whatever hiring needs most that week, no matter the title on it, no task here is too small when a candidate or a deadline is on the line.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience managing complex calendars and using tools such as Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-service mindset.
* High level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Torrance, CA - 5 days onsite

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, or HR coordination.
* Experience using Greenhouse or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience improving or streamlining recruiting or operational processes.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

jobs.title: Integrated Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Role:

**About the Role**

Great marketing is more than a compelling message. It's about reaching the right people, at the right time, with solutions that make a difference in their lives.

At Southland Credit Union, we're looking for an Integrated Marketing Manager who can turn big ideas into meaningful results. In this role, you'll help shape how we attract new Members, strengthen existing relationships, and connect people with financial products and services that support their goals.

Working closely with the VP of Marketing, you'll play a key role in shaping campaign strategy and driving initiatives from initial concept through execution and performance evaluation. This is a role for someone who can see the bigger picture, recognize opportunities, bring forward recommendations, and take ownership of turning strategy into measurable results.

Major Duties and Responsibilities:

**Turning Marketing Strategy Into Action**

Every successful campaign starts with understanding who you're trying to reach, what matters to them, and what you want to accomplish. As the Integrated Marketing Manager, you'll translate organizational priorities into thoughtful marketing strategies that connect the right audiences with the right messages.

You won't simply be executing campaigns that have already been defined. You'll help determine the approach—identifying opportunities, understanding target audiences, shaping messaging, selecting the right channels, and establishing how success will be measured.

You'll lead integrated campaigns across digital advertising, email, websites, social media, direct mail, Financial Center communications, and other marketing channels. By bringing together creative development, compelling storytelling, digital marketing, and audience insights, you'll ensure each campaign delivers a cohesive experience and supports Southland's broader business objectives.

You'll also look for ways to make marketing more relevant and effective through audience segmentation, personalization, testing, and optimization. Your ability to connect business priorities with Member insights and marketing performance will help guide decisions and shape stronger campaigns.

**Driving Campaigns and Cross-Functional Partnerships**

Strong marketing requires more than a good strategy. It takes someone who can bring the right people together, influence direction, and move initiatives forward.

You'll serve as a key Marketing partner to departments including Lending, Operations, Digital Banking, and Member Experience. By understanding their priorities and challenges, you'll identify opportunities to translate business needs into marketing initiatives that attract new Members, encourage product adoption, deepen existing relationships, and support Member engagement.

You'll lead campaign planning and coordination across internal teams, marketing specialists, and external vendors. From developing campaign briefs and providing creative direction to managing timelines, deliverables, and stakeholder feedback, you'll maintain ownership of the work while keeping everyone aligned on the desired outcomes.

This role calls for someone who can confidently make recommendations, exercise sound judgment, and address challenges without waiting for direction at every step. When priorities shift or obstacles arise, you'll identify solutions, manage competing demands, and keep initiatives moving forward.

**Measuring Results and Improving Performance**

Great marketing doesn't end when a campaign launches. Understanding what worked, what didn't, and where opportunities exist is just as important as the strategy behind it.

You'll monitor campaign performance against established objectives and key performance indicators, using marketing analytics, behavioral data, and audience insights to evaluate effectiveness. You'll translate those findings into meaningful recommendations that help improve acquisition, Member engagement, product adoption, and retention.

You'll also oversee campaign budgets, monitor expenditures, and recommend adjustments based on performance and business priorities. Working with Compliance and other stakeholders, you'll coordinate required reviews and approvals to ensure campaigns align with Southland's brand standards, messaging guidelines, and applicable regulatory requirements.

Success means serving as a trusted marketing partner who can independently lead initiatives, influence campaign direction, anticipate challenges, and deliver results. You'll know how to balance the bigger strategic picture with the details required to bring each campaign to life, while continuously looking for ways to improve performance and strengthen Member relationships.

Knowledge and Skills:

**What Helps You Succeed**

**Experience**

* Five or more years of progressive marketing experience, including demonstrated responsibility for developing and executing integrated marketing campaigns.
* Proven ability to independently lead complex, multichannel marketing initiatives from planning through execution and performance evaluation.
* Strong copywriting, editing, and storytelling skills, with experience developing clear, compelling marketing content across digital and traditional channels.
* Experience coordinating cross-functional teams, managing multiple project timelines, and driving accountability without direct supervisory authority.
* Strong understanding of digital marketing, customer acquisition, lifecycle marketing, audience segmentation, and campaign performance measurement.
* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret marketing performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* Experience presenting recommendations and collaborating with stakeholders at various organizational levels.

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Design, Communications, Journalism, Public Relations, Visual Communications, or a related field preferred.

**Who We Are**  
Hi! We’re AntiSocial, a social-first digital marketing agency powered by people who love to create. Our work spans industries and disciplines, from conceptual campaigns and strategic media plans to creator partnerships, influencer strategies, and content production for leading brands around the world. We’re looking for a Community Manager to join our team. You'll be the voice behind some exciting gaming and entertainment brands, building engaged online communities and creating meaningful connections with passionate audiences.

You understand internet culture, know how to adapt your tone of voice for different audiences, and have a knack for turning everyday interactions into opportunities for engagement. jobs.title: Travel Operations Coordinator / 旅行社 OP 專員
jobs.description:
Travel Operations Coordinator / 旅行社 OP 專員

Company｜公司：US Lion Travel 雄獅旅遊洛杉磯

Location｜工作地點： El Monte, CA

Employment Type｜職位類型：Full-time 全職

關於我們｜About Lion Travel

雄獅旅遊為台灣知名旅遊品牌，致力於提供多元且高品質的旅遊產品與服務。US Lion Travel 服務在地及入境美國旅客，提供境內旅遊、亞洲及全球旅遊產品、機票、團體旅遊及客製化行程等服務。

我們正在尋找一位細心、具責任感，並對旅遊產業充滿熱情的 Travel Operations Coordinator（旅行社 OP 專員） 加入洛杉磯團隊。

如果你擅長安排細節、跨部門溝通，認真負責，這會是一個很適合你的職位。

Lion Travel is one of Taiwan’s leading travel brands, providing a wide range of travel products and services including group tours, air tickets, customized itineraries, and destination experiences.

US Lion Travel is looking for a detail-oriented, responsible Travel Operations Coordinator to join our team in Los Angeles office.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys travel planning, coordination, problem-solving, and working behind the scenes to ensure every trip runs smoothly from booking to departure.

主要工作內容｜Key Responsibilities

負責旅遊團體及相關產品之日常 OP 作業與行程執行

協助確認酒店、交通、餐廳、景點門票、導遊及其他旅遊服務

與美國供應商進行預訂後確認入系統, 並產出行程進行交班作業

每個團在走的時候, 給予領隊及出境團隊應有的支援. 包括 after hours 必要的回覆, 處理緊急狀況.

使用公司信用卡預定後的月結作業 (對帳, 支單調整)

追蹤預訂進度、供應商確認狀態及付款相關資訊

協助處理行程異動、臨時狀況及旅途中可能發生的問題

與業務、門市、導遊及其他內部團隊密切合作，確保行程順利執行

視需要協助客戶旅遊相關問題及售後服務

完成主管交辦之其他旅遊營運相關工作

Key responsibilities include:

Coordinate daily operations for group tours and travel products

Inquiry and reservation of hotels, transportation, restaurants, attractions, tour guides, and other travel services

Communicate with local suppliers regarding reservations; itinerary production from system, and hand over file details.

While groups are on tour, support tour guides and outbound team with appropriate back up, including off hours assistance and handling urgent situations.

After use of company credit card, record all transaction as well as reconcile monthly statement for accounting.

Support pre-departure preparation and confirming all reservations before deadline/tour departure

Track booking status, supplier confirmations, deadlines, and payment-related information

Handle itinerary changes, last-minute requests, and operational issues when necessary

Work closely with sales, retail, tour guides, and internal teams to ensure smooth trip execution

Assist with travel product updates, pricing information, and administrative tasks related to product setup

Provide travel-related post tour support and assistance when necessary

Perform other travel operations duties as assigned

我們希望你具備｜Qualifications

大專或以上學歷；旅遊、觀光、飯店管理或相關科系尤佳

具旅行社、旅遊業、航空、飯店、訂位或客戶服務相關經驗者優先

中文及英文溝通能力良好，能以中文處理日常工作內容

熟悉中文輸入及一般電腦文書軟體，如 Microsoft Office / Google Workspace

做事細心、有條理，能同時處理多項工作並掌握時程

良好的溝通、協調及問題處理能力

具責任感、團隊合作精神及服務意識

能適應旅遊產業旺季及臨時行程變動

對加拿大及國際旅遊產品具有興趣

須具備合法於加拿大工作的資格

Qualifications:

College diploma or university degree; education in Tourism, Hospitality, Business, or a related field is an asset

Previous experience in a travel agency, tour operator, airline, hotel, reservations, or customer service environment is preferred

Strong skills in speaking, writing and reading Chinese and English

Comfortable working with Chinese-language travel materials and communication

Proficient in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, and general computer applications

Strong attention to detail and organizational skills

Ability to manage multiple bookings, deadlines, and tasks simultaneously

Strong communication, coordination, and problem-solving abilities

Responsible, service-oriented, and a strong team player

Able to adapt to seasonal workloads and last-minute operational changes

Genuine interest in Canadian and international travel

Must be legally eligible to work in United States

加分條件｜Nice to Have

曾任旅行社 OP、Tour Coordinator、Reservations Agent 或相關職位

熟悉美國本地旅遊產品及熱門旅遊目的地

具團體旅遊操作或地接經驗

Assets:

Previous experience as a Travel Operations Coordinator, Tour Coordinator, Reservations Agent, or similar role

Knowledge of US destinations and local tourism products

Experience handling group tours or destination services

我們正在尋找這樣的你｜Who We’re Looking For

旅行社 OP 不只是「訂飯店、訂車」。

我們希望找到一位願意從旅客出發前的每一個細節開始確認，能與不同供應商及團隊合作，並在突發狀況發生時冷靜找出解決方案的夥伴。

如果你喜歡旅遊，也享受把複雜的行程安排整理得井然有序，我們歡迎你加入 US Lion Travel。

Travel operations is much more than making reservations.

We are looking for someone who takes ownership of the details behind every journey, communicates effectively with suppliers and team members, and stays calm when plans change.

If you enjoy travel, coordination, and turning complex itineraries into smooth travel experiences, we would love to hear from you.

Join US Lion Travel and help us create better journeys for our travelers.

福利制度

* 有薪年假／特休
* 生日月份福利：可選一天有薪生日假
* 健康津貼／補助（彈性運用，照顧你的身心健康）

* 與國際團隊協作機會，拓展全球視野
* 隨著業務擴展，提供成長與升遷空間

Benefits:

* Paid Time Off / Vacation
* Birthday Month Benefit: choose one paid day off during your birthday month
* Health Allowance / Supplement (flexible wellness support)
* Employee travel discounts and perks
* Taiwan-based Sharing Stock Program, connecting you to our global growth journey
* Opportunities to collaborate with international teams and expand your global perspective
* Room to grow as our business and footprint continue to evolve

Job Types: Full-time, Contract, Temporary

Pay: $45,000.00 - $55,000.00 per year

Language:

jobs.title: Production Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

We are seeking an organized and detail-oriented Production Coordinator to monitor production orders, coordinate schedules, and ensure timely delivery of customer orders. This position works closely with Production, Engineering, Purchasing, Quality, Sales, and Management to track job progress, resolve scheduling issues, and maintain efficient production flow.

The ideal candidate will have strong communication and organizational skills, experience in a manufacturing environment, and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced setting.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor production orders and work-in-progress (WIP) to ensure jobs move through manufacturing on schedule.
* Develop, maintain, and communicate daily and weekly production schedules.
* Track job status, identify production delays, and coordinate corrective actions to meet delivery commitments.
* Work with Production, Purchasing, Engineering, and other departments to resolve scheduling conflicts, material shortages, and production issues.
* Expedite priority orders and communicate job status, schedule changes, and delivery updates.
* Participate in production meetings and provide updates on job progress, capacity constraints, and scheduling concerns.
* Maintain accurate production schedules, job information, and status updates in ERP/MRP systems.
* Monitor shipments and communicate potential delays or revised delivery dates to Sales.
* Prepare and review production reports, including backlog, WIP, shipments, and on-time delivery performance.
* Support continuous improvement efforts to improve production flow and scheduling efficiency.
* Assist with production and material handling activities as needed.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree preferred.
* 2+ years of experience in production coordination, scheduling, manufacturing, customer service, or a related role.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office, including Excel, Outlook, and Word.
* Experience using ERP, MRP, or production planning systems.
* Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively with multiple departments in a fast-paced manufacturing environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in PCB manufacturing, electronics manufacturing, or a related production environment.
* Knowledge of production scheduling, capacity planning, material flow, and inventory coordination.
* Experience tracking work-in-progress (WIP), production performance, and delivery schedules.
* Familiarity with manufacturing reports, order management, and production forecasting.

**Work EnvironmentPhysical Requirements**

* Primarily office-based in a manufacturing environment.
* Regular computer use, phone communication, and walking through production areas.
* May occasionally lift up to 15 pounds.
* Ability to attend onsite meetings and occasional business-related travel as needed.

jobs.description:
**Company Description**

NBCUniversal is one of the world’s leading media and entertainment companies. We create world-class content, which we distribute across our portfolio of film, television, and streaming, and bring to life through our global theme park destinations, consumer products, and experiences. We own and operate leading entertainment and news brands, including NBC, NBC News, NBC Sports, Telemundo, NBC Local Stations, Bravo, and Peacock, our premium ad-supported streaming service. We produce and distribute premier filmed entertainment and programming through our powerhouse film and television studios, including Universal Pictures, DreamWorks Animation, and Focus Features, and the four global television studios under the Universal Studio Group banner, and operate industry-leading theme parks and experiences around the world through Universal Destinations & Experiences, including Universal Orlando Resort, home to Universal Epic Universe, and Universal Studios Hollywood. NBCUniversal is a subsidiary of Comcast Corporation. Visit www.nbcuniversal.com for more information.

Our impact is rooted in improving the communities where our employees, customers, and audiences live and work. We have a rich tradition of giving back and ensuring our employees have the opportunity to serve their communities. We champion an inclusive culture and strive to attract and develop a talented workforce to create and deliver a wide range of content reflecting our world.

,

**Job Description**

The Assistant Project Manager supports the planning, coordination, and execution of projects within the Technical Services Project Management Office. The role independently manages assigned smaller or lower-complexity projects and non-safety-critical scopes, while supporting the Program Manager and Project Managers on larger, higher-complexity, or safety-critical projects. Assigned projects may include enhancements, modifications, and replacements of existing theme park attraction systems, equipment, infrastructure, and related facilities. Responsibilities include client and stakeholder coordination, procurement and contract administration, cost and schedule planning, project controls, vendor management, quality oversight, financial reporting, close-out, and warranty management to help ensure project goals and objectives are achieved within approved scope, budget, and schedule.

**Major Responsibilities**

**Project Management and Delivery**

* Independently manage assigned smaller or lower-complexity projects and non-safety-critical scopes through the project lifecycle, with supervision and escalation support from the Program Manager.
* Assist the Program Manager and Project Managers with the planning, coordination, and execution of larger, higher-complexity, or safety-critical projects.
* Lead project kick-off meetings for assigned projects and attend and document kick-off meetings for supported projects.
* Coordinate with project stakeholders, business units, vendors, consultants, contractors, governmental agencies, and internal support groups to facilitate project decisions, application submissions, approvals, site access, and execution.
* Identify, analyze, and respond to project risks and issues; develop recommended mitigation actions and keep the Program Manager and stakeholders advised of material developments.
* Monitor and track overall project progress and distribute regular status reports to the Program Manager and project stakeholders & clients.
* Research and facilitate resolution of project issues, independently for assigned projects and in collaboration with the Program Manager or Project Manager when supporting larger efforts.

**Procurement, Contracts, and Vendor Management**

* Prepare contract and procurement documents, including Scopes of Work, milestone schedules, bidder lists, and supporting bid documentation, and coordinate the RFP and competitive bid process with Sourcing and Legal.
* Manage and coordinate selected project vendors and perform oversight of vendor contracts for assigned projects, including evaluation of technical performance and adherence to contract requirements.
* Manage vendor submittals, requests for information, modification documents, directives, potential change orders, and change order requests; perform quality control and compile documentation for approval.
* Review payment applications and invoices from general contractors, architects, consultants, and other vendors for completeness, accuracy, supporting documentation, and alignment with project progress.
* Coordinate security and site access for vendors as required.

**Project Controls, Documentation, and Financial Management**

* Develop, track, and maintain project schedules and budgets in the company project management system.
* Monitor schedule changes and delays, evaluate contractor schedule performance, coordinate schedule interfaces with other groups and departments, and develop mitigation plans when milestones are at risk.
* Monitor and control impacts to project scope and budget; identify and communicate potential impacts to the Program Manager and prepare project control requests for executive review, as required.
* Collaborate with Project Controls and PMO leadership on monthly cost reports, cash flows, forecasts, and other required reporting.
* Perform final quality review of contracts, invoices, bid milestones, funding documents, and other project documentation before submission for department approvals.
* Maintain complete electronic and project files with documented backup necessary for audit and archival purposes.
* Coordinate with Finance, Controllership, and Fixed Assets for final project capitalization and provide supporting cost and quantity information as needed.

**Quality, Close-Out, and Warranty**

* Monitor quality assurance for assigned projects, including regular site walks to verify progress and confirm that work is being performed in accordance with contract requirements.

**Position Overview**

The Kick Law Firm, APC is seeking a highly capable **Executive Legal Assistant** to provide dedicated, high-trust support to the Managing Partner. This role goes beyond traditional legal support - the ideal candidate is a fast-learning, resourceful generalist who can be entrusted with a wide range of executive-level projects, including matters related to real estate and development, alongside select legal and litigation exposure.

We are looking for exceptional judgment, discretion, and the intellectual horsepower to take on new and varied types of work with minimal direction. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent graduate of a top college or university who is smart, articulate, and eager to build real professional experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Executive & Personal Support**

* Serve as the Managing Partner's primary administrative partner: prioritize requests, manage calendars, and coordinate meetings, travel, and logistics.

* Take ownership of a variety of executive-level projects, which will include legal work, but also may include real estate, business development, and other ventures outside the scope of traditional legal work.

* Handle confidential legal and business information with exceptional discretion.

**Legal Exposure (as needed)**

* Provide litigation and legal-administrative support as needed, with the opportunity to grow into more substantive legal work over time.

* Use AI tools where useful to support research, document review, and organization.

* Manage calendars with exceptional attention to detail for hearings and deadlines, in addition to personal calendars.

* Save and organize court documents and client files.

* Send, review, scan, and save mail correspondence.

* Make calls to clients and prospective clients.

* Print documents and prepare binders for hearings and depositions.

* Conduct inventory and order office supplies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree from a top-tier college or university.

* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, judgment, and attention to detail.

* Comfort managing multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, small-office environment.

* Ability to work hybrid or full-time in-office (if preferred) with dependable availability.

* High degree of professionalism, critical thinking, discretion, and trustworthiness.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Some prior work experience (internship, part-time, or summer employment) demonstrating professional readiness - e.g., comfort with business communication and workplace norms.

* Interest in law, business, or real estate; prior legal experience is not necessarily required.

* Track record of anticipating needs and delivering solutions that exceed expectations.

This role goes beyond a traditional assistant position, and compensation is structured accordingly. The REMM Group is seeking a strategic and talented bilingual Assistant Manager for two beautiful communities located in Anaheim, CA, and Garden Grove, CA. The assistant property manager will be responsible for supervising the overall operations of the community and maintaining its physical assets and financial performance. The candidate must have previous multi-family and rent collection experience, excellent communication and organizational skills, and strong leadership qualities. **The candidate must also be bilingual in English/Spanish, have Yardi knowledge**, and be able to effectively manage, mentor, and motivate their team. **The working schedule is Monday - Friday, 8:00 am-5:00 pm. No housing discount is available for this position.**

Are you a dynamic bilingual assistant property manager looking to apply your prior experiences to an exciting and rewarding opportunity? Do you thrive in a fast-paced environment and enjoy providing exceptional customer service? Are you organized, detail-oriented, and possess a passion for the property management industry? If so, we want to hear from you! Join one of the fastest-growing privately held companies in the real estate management industry and enjoy work-life balance in a fun, team-oriented environment.

**This Job Might Be for You If You Can Excel at:**

* Assisting the Business Manager with the management of the assigned community by fulfilling all aspects of property operations, including lease administration, rent collection, move-in/move-out processes, and administrative responsibilities as established by the Business Manager and The REMM Group.
* Manage tenant relations by addressing inquiries, resolving maintenance requests, and enforcing lease policies in a professional and courteous manner.
* Conduct property tours, screen potential tenants, and process rental applications using Yardi Voyager or RentCafe.
* Maintain accurate and up-to-date resident records and financial reports using property management software.
* Coordinate with vendors and service providers to ensure timely completion of maintenance requests.
* Perform routine property inspections and report any maintenance needs.
* Market vacant units and contribute to developing and implementing marketing strategies.
* Provides leadership to the team with a focus on strong team development.
* Promotes client satisfaction and retention.
* Ensures that the community meets the established operational, financial, and business performance goals.
* Ensures that the appearance and physical aspects of the properties meet the Company's established standards.
* Demonstrating significant initiative, discretion, personal awareness, professionalism, integrity, independent judgment, and exercise confidence and confidentiality in all areas of performance.
* Communicating with residents including maintenance requests, resident relations, community activities, community procedures, move-out security deposit allocations, and conflict resolution.
* Collecting and depositing outstanding monies due to the community in a secure and timely manner. Process pay or quit notices, contact residents regarding delinquencies, and prepare/submit files to the legal department. May be required to represent the organization as an agent for the owner in court-related matters.

**Qualifications and Experience:**

* Minimum of two (2) years of experience in multifamily property management or related business operations.
* Operational skills including budget sales and marketing.
* Minimum of three (3) years of supervisory experience in property management or related business operations.
* **Proficiency with Yardi and RentCafe software is preferred.**
* **Must be Bilingual in English/Spanish.**
* Must have reliable transportation.
* Excellent customer service skills with the ability to build rapport and resolve tenant concerns effectively.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

jobs.description:
Do you take real pride in the craft of operational leadership — the kind that makes complex enterprise relationships feel effortless to the customer and unlocks the growth teammates can see but not always reach? Are you the person who anticipates issues before they surface, orchestrates internal resources with quiet mastery, and gets satisfaction from making the machine work? **If your answers are yes, please read on.**

As a **Strategic Account Manager (SAM)** at Pacific Rim Capital (PRC), you will be the day-to-day operational owner for a portfolio of PRC's most important Fortune 500 relationships. You will ensure existing business is flawlessly executed, coordinate internal resources across the company, build strong operational relationships with customer stakeholders, and partner with senior sales colleagues on account strategy — all in service of retention, portfolio performance, and continued customer growth.

This role offers a competitive base salary plus commission tied to account performance.

PRC is one of North America's largest *independent* providers of equipment financing and leasing solutions, with nearly $2 billion in assets under management. We finance material handling equipment (MHE), IT, warehouse automation, energy, and over-the-road vehicles for Fortune 500 clients across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico.

* **Improve continuously —** identify opportunities to improve program efficiency, customer satisfaction, and portfolio performance through process improvements and operational recommendations.
* **Partner with sales on account strategy —** work closely with senior sales colleagues to execute account strategies that increase retention, expand PRC's footprint within the customer, and strengthen PRC's strategic position.
* **Maintain institutional memory —** keep comprehensive account plans, relationship maps, and customer activity records that support continuity, visibility, and effective succession planning.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Valar Atomics**

At Valar Atomics, we're redefining what's possible in energy. Our mission is to make clean, high-temperature nuclear power scalable, unlocking abundant energy for industry, hydrogen, and next-generation manufacturing. We are a team of builders, engineers, and operators who believe nuclear energy should be fast to deploy, factory-made, and built for the real world. Our first pilot plant in Orangeville, Utah will demonstrate how advanced nuclear systems and fuel fabrication can power the future. Joining Valar Atomics means becoming part of a company where autonomy, ownership, and impact exist at every level.

**The Team**

As part of the Business organization, People and Talent attracts, develops, and supports the exceptional individuals who drive Valar's success. The team partners across the company to build a high-performing organization through recruiting, employee development, engagement, and people operations.

**The Role**

Valar is hiring across all orgs and the volume keeps climbing. We're looking for a Recruiting Coordinator to carry live searches from week one: scheduling interviews, hosting candidates onsite, managing travel, and keeping Greenhouse accurate across every pipeline in flight. Our coordination team already runs a working process, built for a smaller company than the one we're becoming. You'll step into it, then improve it. Competing calendars, late cancellations, and shifting priorities are the normal condition here, and you'll be trusted to resolve most of it yourself. Candidates meet Valar through you first.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own interview scheduling across teams, time zones, and sites, including the multi-panel days.
* Host candidates onsite and run the day so interviewers and candidates always know where they stand.
* Coordinate candidate travel and review the expenses
* Own Greenhouse data hygiene: stage accuracy, interview kits, scorecard completion, clean candidate records.
* Close the gap between offer accepted and first day: background checks, paperwork, and the handoff to People Operations.
* Resolve scheduling conflicts on your own judgment, bringing recruiters and hiring managers the tradeoff and your recommendation rather than the raw problem.
* Keep pipelines moving with recruiters and hiring managers, flagging stalled candidates and interviewer bottlenecks before a search goes cold.
* Learn what we build and who we hire well enough to answer a candidate's questions yourself.
* Improve the coordination process as you learn it: bring the problem, the proposed fix, then the implementation.
* Pitch in on whatever hiring needs most that week, no matter the title on it, no task here is too small when a candidate or a deadline is on the line.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience managing complex calendars and using tools such as Outlook and Microsoft Office.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with a customer-service mindset.
* High level of organization with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.
* Comfortable working both independently and as part of a team.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Torrance, CA - 5 days onsite

**Preferred Skills and Experience**

* 2+ years of experience in recruiting coordination, talent operations, or HR coordination.
* Experience using Greenhouse or a similar Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Bachelor's degree.
* Experience improving or streamlining recruiting or operational processes.

**Equal Employment Opportunity Statement**

Valar Atomics is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected status under applicable law.

We are committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination and harassment and will provide reasonable accommodation as required by law.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (green card holder).

Tustin, CA
