**The Company**

VeSync is a portfolio company with brands that cover different categories of health & wellness products. We wouldn't be surprised if you have one of our Levoit air purifiers in your living room or a COSORI air fryer whipping up healthy and delicious meals for you every night.

We're a young and energetic company, we've had tremendous success, and we are constantly growing our team. As we garner more industry attention — just check out our accomplishments and awards by CES Innovation, iF Design, IGA, and Red Dot — we also need driven and talented people to join our team.

That brings us to you, and what you'll be joining. Our teams are smart and diligent and take ownership of their work — they're confident in their work but know how to collaborate with open ears and a spirit of learning. If you're down-to-earth, approachable, and easy to strike up a conversation with, this may be a great fit for you.

  

**Check out our other brands**:

levoit.com | cosori.com | etekcity.com

  

**The Opportunity**

A new ecosystem at the intersection of wellness and technology, with a connected product, hardware and software, built to help people take an active role in their own health rather than simply measure it. The Social Media Manager owns the social presence behind that launch, from the first post through the audience we build.

Your job is to decide what each channel is for, build the content that fills it, and grow an audience from a standing start. You'll set the strategy and make the work, engage the people who show up, and build the credibility that turns attention into members. We are pre-launch, and the brand, the positioning, and the claims we can make are all still being built. You'll work alongside that, not after it. It's a hands-on role.

### **What you will do at VeSync:**

**Channel Strategy & Audience**

* **Own the Channel Strategy**: Define what each channel is for, the role it plays from first impression through consideration, and the goal it carries. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, Threads, Reddit, and what comes next.
* **Own the Audience Build**: Grow the audience from a standing start. Audience and engagement growth are numbers you own, with an approach behind them.
* **Turn Positioning into Channel-Native Content**: Take the positioning and claims framework owned by Product Marketing and turn it into content that works on each channel, adapted rather than copied across. Both are being written now, so expect to work from drafts and adjust as they settle.

**Content & Voice**

* **Own the Calendar and the Formats**: Build the programming calendar, the repeatable formats behind it, and the production cadence that keeps it fed.
* **Make the Work**: Concept, write, shoot, edit, and publish. Creative and agency partners support you, they don't do it for you.
* **Hold the Voice and the Claims Line**: Keep a consistent brand voice across channels, and work inside the medical, regulatory, and claims review process rather than around it.

**Engagement & Performance**

* **Drive Engagement on Owned Channels**: Reply to comments, answer DMs, and take part in the conversation under our own posts. Route product issues and escalations to CX.
* **Show Up on Reddit and in Forums**: Hold our presence in the places this product gets discussed by people who know it well. These are spaces we don't control, and they reward participation over promotion.
* **Own the Numbers**: Set the metrics and KPIs for each channel, report performance honestly, and turn what the data says into what gets made next.

### **What you bring to the role:**

* **Education**: Bachelor's degree required.
* **Experience**: 5+ years managing social media for consumer (B2C) brands, with hands-on direct-to-consumer (DTC) experience. Health & wellness, consumer hardware, and subscription or membership backgrounds are strongly preferred.
* **New Brand & Audience Build**: Proven track record launching a brand, sub-brand, or product line into an audience that did not previously exist.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity**: Can build while the brand, the positioning, and the claims framework are still being settled. Makes progress on partial information, changes direction when decisions land, and doesn't fill the gaps by inventing positioning of their own.
* **Platform Native**: Fluent in the craft and the culture of each channel and in how they differ. Comfortable in forums and communities you don't control, where publishing like a brand doesn't work.
* **Hands-On Maker**: Concepts, writes, shoots, and edits. Produces the content, not only the brief.
* **Claims & Regulatory Fluency**: Experience in health, wellness, medical device, supplements, or a similarly regulated space. Knows what to avoid, and how to say something true and interesting inside real constraints.
* **Analytical**: Sets metrics and KPIs, reads performance honestly, and uses it to decide what to make next. Able to argue engagement quality over vanity metrics and back it with evidence.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**: Partners closely with paid social, brand and creative, product, and CX.

We are committed to our employee fulfillment by providing a flexible work schedule, honoring achievements, and maintaining a transparent working environment. Getac strives to promote an inclusive culture to create a workplace that reflects the diversity of the communities it serves. We are looking for growth mindset team members to help lead the way.

* We are a team full of employees that believe in by working together we win together
* We offer a generous health care policy, PTO, and 401(K) with a 3% Contribution
* We believe in making a difference every day
* Performance based bonuses

**The Position**

The Inside Sales Representative for the **Federal Sales Team** will work closely with GETAC’s Federal Account Executives to increase net new company revenue throughout the supported area. The ISM will support the **Federal Sales Team** and its Channel Partners with qualified leads/opportunities that are viable prospects for immediate sales attention. The ISM is the ‘direct-touch’ liaison between GETAC’s outside sales team and GETAC’s internal resources for all sales related issues. The ISM has the ability to contribute to GETAC’s overall business development and support of our business partners. This position balances:

* Operational Sales Support
* Database Management / Lead Vetting
* Pre / post-sales activities with the main focus of growing the sales funnel/pipeline and achieving sales revenue growth.

**Essential Job Duties**

* Lead generation – pre-qualify leads from WEB, call-ins (phone) and tradeshow prospects, prior to submission to Sales Team for follow-up.
* Database Management for Team/Channel Partners on possible new sales opportunity recruitment. Data input requires current and accurate analysis of sales channel pipeline on a weekly basis using Salesforce.
* Interacts daily with Team/Channel Partners - providing quotes and support for requests, follows-up on sales orders, reviews/verifies incoming PO’s, assists with demo requests, co-ordinates partner sales training, escalates service issues.
* Efficient communication with Team/Channel Partners regarding rules of engagement and business operating procedures with GETAC to ensure effective communication between all parties.
* Closes out shipped opportunities in Salesforce and provides SPA #, PO# from distribution, & tracking number in latest updates.
* Monitors BI for orders received in area and matches information to a corresponding opportunity in Salesforce.
* Manages ‘deals desk’ and/or dealer price protection process and tracking, while maintaining channel program records of correspondence, bid requests, credit collection.
* Ensures Team and Business Partners are up-to-date with current pricing, marketing/sales collateral and products/services information.
* Increase and Monitor pipeline for Team, scheduling meetings and product presentations with potential clients.
* Initiate customization requests to Solutions Architects via Salesforce.
* Manage and support Team daily order process including quote and product configuration verification.
* Provide Team with weekly inventory report for current availability of GETAC inventory status for quick sales.
* Ability to present product training seminars to Channel Partners with Team.

Other Duties

* Attends staff, departmental, and required meetings.
* Travel to all team business reviews
* Travel to Trade Shows and Partner Presentations

Experience & Education

* Requires 3+ years of sales account management. Ability to multi-task projects and escalates Pre-sales issues in a timely manner.
* Strong communication and presentation skills.
* Must have prior industry knowledge on rugged computer products and hardware/software vendors by industry verticals.
* Proven success communicating and collaborating with both technical and non-technical audiences. Self-driven and well-organized.
* Able to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience with cold calling, lead generation and qualifying potential clients / Web Research. Excellent verbal and written skills are needed.
* Knowledge of sales proposal management (RFQ, NDA, RFI) and coordination with internal departments for document submittal.
* Strong pro-active initiative to learn about new product releases and improving personal sales recruitment skills.
* Experience with internal sales distribution and forecasting systems and contracts management processes are required.
* Prior experience in a position that interfaces with internal company business units, HQ business units and 3rd party business partners is desired.

Computer & Software Skills  
  
Must have foundational computer skills including: Microsoft Office Suite (Outlook email and calendaring) and the Internet.  
  
Travel

* Occasional local travel
* Must have a valid California Driver’s License, proof of current vehicle insurance and a driving record that meets the companies insurer’s criteria; must be able to use own vehicle in the course of work.

**The Location**

This position would report to our Irvine office in CA. This is a hybrid role that offers 3 days in office and 2 days remote after 90 days.

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Great Benefits, interesting work
* Reasonable Hours to preserve a positive work/life balance
* Engaging, supportive culture – we have FUN!
* No outside recruiting is required

***Getac is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.***

jobs.title: Estimator/ Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**BAKER FLOORING AND SURFACES**

**Estimator / Project Coordinator**

Job Description

**Department**

Estimating & Project Administration

**Reports to**

[President / Operations Manager]

**Location**

Burlingame, CA (hybrid or in-office)

**Employment type**

Full-time

**FLSA / CA status**

[Non-exempt (hourly) / Exempt]

**Pay range**

$98,000 – $108,000 per year, plus performance bonus

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Estimator / Project Coordinator prices commercial flooring and surface services work, helps win it, and then carries each awarded project from contract through closeout. This role owns the bid and the project paperwork, working closely with Operations, which manages crews and field performance, and with Accounting, which handles invoicing and collections.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Estimating and Bid Management**

* Review incoming bid invitations, accept bids, and assign them to the appropriate estimator or division.

* Prepare estimates using takeoffs, vendor quotes, and the company labor rate sheet; keep the rate sheet current.

* Request and follow up on pricing from suppliers and vendors by phone and email.

* Incorporate drive time and overtime into labor pricing.

* Prepare RFIs, manage bid deadlines, and submit complete proposals on time.

* Enter each bid in Salesforce with the client project manager’s contact information and the latest proposal.

**Contract Award Review**

* Verify that the company’s legal name, scopes of work, and dollar values on each contract match the awarded bid.

* Confirm inclusions and exclusions are clearly stated and priced, including power/generators, floor protection, floor preparation, demolition, and adhesive removal.

* Compare scheduled days and work dates against the time required to perform the work.

* Track pre-lien notices.

**Project Coordination**

* Schedule job starts and project timelines with clients and Operations.

* Review contracts in detail, route them through DocuSign as needed, and negotiate or correct changes with clients.

* Obtain contact information for each client’s project manager and superintendent.

* Obtain insurance requirements from the general contractor or contract and coordinate certificates of insurance with the company’s insurance broker.

* Prepare, submit, and track submittals and samples through approval.

* Order materials for awarded projects.

* Attend Project Labor Agreement (PLA) meetings.

* Upload budgets, contracts, and project documents to Procore.

* Collect work tags from Operations, prepare change order requests (CORs), and track them through approval.

* Maintain budgeted production rates, using closeout feedback from Operations to refine future estimates.

* Complete project closeout documentation.

**Billing Coordination**

* Notify Accounting when billing milestones are reached, including submittals sent, materials ordered, mockups completed, stages of work completed, and final completion.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 3 to 5 years of estimating experience in commercial flooring, finishes, or a related trade.

* Working knowledge of takeoffs, labor productivity, and material costs.

* Ability to read and interpret contracts, scopes of work, insurance requirements, and prevailing-wage or PLA provisions.

* Proficiency with Salesforce, Procore, DocuSign, Microsoft Excel, and email.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

* Clear written and verbal communication with general contractors, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Simpro or QuickBooks.

* Procore certification or formal estimating training.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

Work is primarily office-based, with occasional job walks and PLA meetings at active construction sites, which may require walking on uneven surfaces and wearing personal protective equipment. Bid deadlines may require extended hours during busy periods. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS**

* Base pay: $98,000 – $108,000 per year, based on experience and qualifications.

* Performance bonus: 5% to 10% of base pay, tied to bid success at target margin, on-time submissions, and contract and insurance turnaround.

* Medical insurance, with the company covering the majority of the employee-only premium.

* 15 days of paid time off plus paid company holidays.

* 401(k) with a 3% to 4% company match.

* Reimbursement of necessary business expenses, including mileage and phone.

* $1,000 to $1,500 annual professional development allowance.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER**

Baker Flooring and Surfaces is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.

*This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed. It is not an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or qualifications, and may be changed at any time at the company’s discretion. It does not constitute an employment contract; employment is at-will.*

Pay: $98,000.00 - $108,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Mateo, CA 94402

We are looking for a reliable, organized, and proactive **Construction Project Coordinator / Assistant** to support our day-to-day construction activities, project management, material sourcing, and design coordination.

This is a hands-on position for someone who enjoys being out in the field, visiting different locations, solving problems, and getting things done.

Key Responsibilities

**Jobsite Visits & Coordination**

* Visit residential construction sites throughout the Bay Area.
* Take progress photos, check project status, and provide updates.
* Coordinate with contractors, subcontractors, and vendors as directed.
* Follow up on pending work, material requirements, and deliveries.
* Assist with project inspections and scheduling.

**Material Sourcing & Purchasing**

* Visit Home Depot, Lowe's, building supply stores, kitchen cabinet showrooms, tile stores, lighting stores, and other vendors.
* Research product options, pricing, specifications, and availability.
* Collect material samples, quotations, and product information.
* Pick up and deliver small materials and samples as needed.
* Coordinate orders, pickups, and deliveries.

* Assist with submitting, collecting, and following up on permit documents under company direction.

Requirements

* Comfortable visiting active construction sites, city offices, and suppliers.

What We Offer

* Direct involvement in residential development projects from planning through completion.

Applicants should confirm their ability to travel regularly to different Bay Area locations.

jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**About Convey**
----------------

Every growing company runs on an invisible operating layer: recurring work that crosses a dozen systems and still needs a person to move it forward. Convey is a digital workforce platform. We take that work off the team and give it to digital teammates that the company's own operators train and manage. Each teammate owns a responsibility from the first request to the finished result.

Customers like TelevisaUnivision, Savoya, and Strategus use Convey for work that stands between the business and its revenue. Strategus cut integration launches from three to six months down to under one week.

**About the role**
------------------

We sell to executives, and you'll create the rooms where they meet us. You'll own Convey's field events and event speaking opportunities, and make them the in-person engine of our account-based motion: executive dinners and roundtables, our own events, and the right presence at the right industry events. Working hand in hand with sales, you'll make sure every event starts from our target accounts and ends in meetings and pipeline.

You'll also build the team differently. Alongside the core job, you'll train and manage your own digital workforce on Convey. Those teammates will own the recurring research, tracking, and follow-up work that usually takes over a field marketer's week, so your time goes to strategy, experiences, and relationships. You'll be customer zero for the product you're marketing.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Event strategy and budget**

* Build and own the field events plan and budget, chosen around where our target accounts and executive buyers actually gather.
* Decide where we show up and how: sponsorships, hosted side events, booths, or not at all.

**Executive and hosted events**

* Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, breakfasts, and workshops around key industry events and in our priority markets.
* Create events we host ourselves, from small executive gatherings to customer and community events.

**Speaking opportunities**

* Source, pitch, and secure speaking slots for our executives and customers at events that reach our buyers. Partner with brand marketing on each executive's point of view and talk.
* Turn every talk into conversations with target accounts.

**Account-based execution**

* Partner with account executives and demand generation to build invite lists from target accounts, and run the outreach before each event and the follow-up after.
* Own the handoff: every attendee conversation reaches the right seller quickly, with context.

**Measurement**

* Track every event from invite to pipeline: target account attendance, meetings, and pipeline sourced and influenced. Report on it every week and cut what doesn't work.
* Keep event data clean in the CRM and marketing platforms.

**Vendors and logistics**

* Manage venues, agencies, production, swag, travel, and budgets, with the same bar for a 12-person dinner as for a 2,000-person conference.

**Your digital workforce**

* Decide which recurring field work to delegate. Examples include event research and calendars, speaking submission tracking, invite list building and account research, RSVP and logistics tracking, attendee follow-up prep, and post-event reporting.
* Train those teammates, review their work, and keep improving them as programs change.
* Share what works so it shapes how Convey markets with Convey and how we tell the story to customers.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 5+ years in field or event marketing at B2B SaaS companies with a sales-led motion that sells to enterprise executives.
* Executive events that produced meetings and pipeline, not just attendance. You can show the numbers.
* Experience running events as part of an account-based program, in close partnership with sales.
* Experience securing speaking slots and preparing speakers.
* A strong operator. You run budgets, vendors, and logistics without dropping details.
* Fluency in CRM and marketing platforms. You report on event results yourself.
* Comfort with regular travel.
* Real fluency with AI, and the urge to hand off whole processes rather than just doing pieces of them faster.
* Experience marketing AI or enterprise software platforms.

**Why join**
------------

* Build the field program for a new category from the ground up.
* Use the product to build your team. You'll know the customer's experience better than anyone.
* Help shape the marketing organization early.

jobs.title: Event Services Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
Event Services Client Account Manager

**Overview**
------------

Company Overview:

Kick off your exciting career in Event Security with Allied Universal® Event Services, the go-to leader in crowd management and event staffing. Dive into the action at sports stadiums, concerts, festivals, and convention centers, and thrive on the energy of being where it all happens. Join a lively team that services thousands of venues each year, ensuring safety and fun for everyone. Enjoy the perks of a flexible work schedule that fits your lifestyle—ideal for students, retirees, or anyone seeking a dynamic job. We offer job opportunities in event staff, security, and operations. Join our welcoming, collaborative, and innovative team, and benefit from a range of perks depending on your role and hours. At Allied Universal®, every day brings a new adventure. Ready to make your mark in the event industry? Join us and be part of the excitement!

**Job Description**
-------------------

Allied Universal® is hiring a Client Account Manager. This position is responsible for the day-to-day operations and overseeing events at an assigned account in the east bay region. Account managers also build, improve, and maintain relationships with clients and employees, develop and retain staff, and coordinate needed support services and solve problems to effectively run the account and event operations. Through knowledge of the principles and practices used in successful event management, this position is responsible for show preparation up and through its closeout, while adhering to all applicable policies and procedures. Duties include the provisioning of leadership and direction to subordinate staff, supervisors, and front-line crew members while maintaining the highest levels of employee morale, safety, service, appearance, and performance.

The salary for this position is $90,000 to $100,000 annually.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Supervise the day-to-day event operations and staffing of an assigned client site
* Manage a team of event supervisors and event staff including hiring/selection, scheduling, payroll, training, coaching, development and support, discipline, and terminations
* Build, improve, and maintain effective relationships with both client and employees
* Coordinate necessary support services to effectively manage client site to meet or exceed financial and operational goals and provide quality customer service
* Ensure all required reporting and contract compliance requirements are met
* Assure regular communication of issues or event with our client
* Handle any escalated security issues or emergency situations appropriately
* Communicate staffing needs via Requisition Form; assist recruiters in identifying, interviewing, and hiring quality candidates
* Develop staff in both technical and professional skills through performance management (coaching, counseling, disciplining, training, annual formal performance evaluations, recognition, etc.)
* Assure communication of policies, company announcements and job openings through a consistently updated READ file at each site
* Meet all contractual scheduled hours with a minimum of unbilled overtime
* Coordinate and/or conduct site-specific OJT, client-specific training, and annual refresher training for event security and event staff personnel, as well as meet Allied Universal’s corporate training standards
* Develop and maintain operational procedures so that a valid, site-specific post orders are always available for emergency reference by the event staff
* Manage uniforms, equipment, supplies, and vehicles utilized at the account(s), maintaining appropriate inventories and maintenance checklists
* Take a proactive role in communicating with the client and meeting their needs; meet regularly, listen to issues, provide security and technical expertise and solutions; ensure complete customer satisfaction
* Capably utilize ABI and WinTeam for scheduling and billing, and to produce reports (such as Scheduling Activity, invoice Aging by tiers, Training Summary and Training Detail reports) that require interpretation and action for effective business management
* Enforce Allied Universal Event Services policies as outlined in the handbooks, executive memos and on the portal
* Attend client meetings, security meetings, and event walk-through(s)
* Ensure all staff is debriefed properly and prepared for each event
* Prepare and disseminate event post orders to each employee working each event as assigned venue/event
* Ensure all labor laws are being adhered to (rest and meal periods executed per law, check-in/check-out procedure is followed, etc.)
* Promote Grooming and Appearance Policy by looking professional and appropriate at all times and enforcing that policy within the ranks
* Maintain constant communication with direct manager regarding client issues or concerns, employee performance issues, guest complaints, injuries, or other important facts related to account/event assigned
* Create venue dot maps deployment sheets, show grids, etc.
* Complete and submit all paperwork (incident reports, workers compensation filings, etc.) according to policy, along with the event file, to direct manager
* Oversee and maintain Core staffing, key position succession, and monitor scheduled personnel/shifts
* Facilitate the timely invoicing of events and follows up with client to ensure payment; investigate and mitigate any impediments to the invoicing and payment process in conjunction with the Finance Manager

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
* Minimum of three (3) years of event management, event operations, and/or event supervisory experience
* Experience in hiring, developing, motivating, and retaining quality staff
* Ability to develop and grow customer relationships
* Ability to work in a team-oriented management environment wi

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.description:
**About Climb**
===============

Climb is an AI-native Data & AI consultancy and Databricks partner. We help healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance companies get data and AI projects out of pilot and into production. Instead of large consulting teams, we staff small, senior engineering pods on fixed-scope engagements that reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.

We build long-term partnerships with the data teams we work with, and we grow our people the same way: through direct mentorship from founders and senior architects and real exposure to enterprise deals from day one.

**Role Summary**
================

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to open new accounts for Climb across regulated industries. You'll research companies running on Databricks or evaluating it, find the business problems their data teams are stuck on, and start conversations with the people who own them. You'll pair directly with a senior member of Climb’s GTM team and work alongside our solution architects and Databricks account teams on every pursuit, and you'll see how enterprise consulting deals are scoped and won.

We don't have a big-brand inbound engine. Every meeting we book comes from someone who found the right account, figured out who owned the problem, and started a real conversation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Drive new-logo acquisition across healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance accounts.
* Build and manage pipeline through outbound prospecting across phone, email and LinkedIn, plus referrals and industry events.
* Plan and run account-based campaigns into named target accounts, coordinated with marketing and your Databricks counterparts.
* Build relationships across data, IT, compliance and executive leadership, and understand who decides what.
* Identify business challenges and translate them into data, analytics and AI opportunities our architects can scope.
* Run discovery on early-stage opportunities and co-run deals alongside your sales partner.
* Co-sell with Databricks account teams on shared accounts in your territory, and run a recurring sync with your assigned Databricks account executives and partner managers.
* Collaborate with solution architects and delivery leads to shape winning pursuits.
* Travel to represent Climb at client meetings, Databricks events, industry forums and Climb-hosted workshops.
* Track your activity and results, and help shape the playbook as we grow.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **30 days:** You know our offerings and target accounts, and you've met your Databricks counterparts and set a recurring sync with each.
* **60 days:** You're booking qualified meetings you sourced yourself every week.
* **90 days:** You're consistently hitting your pipeline target and have contributed to at least one active opportunity.
* **6 months:** You're at full pipeline target, running discovery on your own, and co-running opportunities with your GTM partner.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years in a BDR or SDR seat, with a track record of meetings you sourced yourself, not just inbound follow-up.
* Experience selling to technical, IT or data buyers. Backgrounds in data infrastructure, cloud, developer tools or technical recruiting are a strong fit.
* Comfort with cold calling and hunting for contacts, and the ability to explain why you went after an account and why you started with the person you did.
* Ability to research accounts and understand buyer personas and decision-making structures.
* Curiosity about how data platforms and AI work, and the drive to learn the technology well enough to discuss it with an engineer.
* Strong client-facing presence and clear, concise writing.
* Bonus: Experience in or selling into healthcare, life sciences, financial services or insurance.

**Who Thrives Here**
====================

This role is designed for BDRs who build their own pipeline today and are growing toward owning accounts and closing deals.

* You'd rather build your own target list than wait for inbound leads.
* You know why you're calling an account, and who owns the problem, before you pick up the phone.
* You're curious about how data and AI work, and you're not shy about asking an engineer to explain it.
* You take rejection in stride and make the next call just as sharp.

**Why Climb**
=============

* **Learn from the builders.** Work directly with founders and senior architects from your first week.
* **Room to grow.** A clear path to Account Executive, with a promotion review at 12 months tied to sourced pipeline and conversion.
* **Where enterprise AI happens.** A front-row view of the Databricks ecosystem and enterprise AI work.
* **Ground floor opportunity.** Join early alongside seasoned founders to help construct our growth playbook from day one.
* **Focus on outcomes.** We measure success by tangible business value and account expansion rather than arbitrary utilization metrics.
* **Senior engineering pods.** Work directly with elite technical teams and AI tooling, free from management bloat.
* **Compounding IP.** Every enterprise win builds reusable assets and technical blueprints back into our firm.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive base plus uncapped variable
* MacBook Pro and swag kit so you can do your best work
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
* Generous holidays and flexible PTO
* 401(k) with company match
* Professional development budget including Databricks and cloud certifications
* Spot bonuses for relevant certifications
* Conference attendance and thought leadership opportunities
* Collaborative, low-ego culture with direct access to leadership
* Opportunity to shape a growing practice from the ground floor

Climb is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicant

Position Summary

The Program Coordinator will provide administrative and operational support for the WINGS+++ study in Orange County, NY, including coordinating recruitment and data collection, and will serve as liaison to community partners.

WINGS+++ is a NIDA-funded study (R61/R33) within the Social Intervention Group (SIG) at the Columbia University School of Social Work. The study is developing and testing an mHealth intervention with peer navigation for women in Orange County, New York, who use opioids or other drugs and who are affected by intimate partner violence (IPV) and trauma. The WINGS+++ intervention includes three self-paced mHealth sessions that screen for and address opioid and other substance use, IPV, and post-traumatic stress, combined with peer navigation that links women to medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) and other substance use treatment, IPV, mental health, and social services. The study is conducted in close partnership with Orange County community organizations and includes a pilot trial. Under the direction of and reporting to the Project Director, the Program Coordinator will provide administrative and operational support to study research and administrative needs.

* Coordinate participant recruitment and retention through the 12-month follow-up.
* Manage study petty cash & reimbursements, maintain records, schedules, and reports.
* Represent the study at community events and presentations to build awareness.

***THIS POSITION IS GRANT-FUNDED. CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT IS CONTINGENT ON FUNDING AVAILABILITY.***

jobs.description:
FASHIONPHILE is more than just fashion — we’re revolutionizing the ultra-luxury fashion experience in order to create a sustainable alternative that extends the life cycle of products and makes them more accessible to a diverse customer base. As we strive to become the world's most sought-after brand in luxury re-commerce, we know it's our team members who make it all happen! We value diversity in our people, perspectives, and products. For us, it's the only way to cultivate the creativity and innovation essential to achieving our mission and supporting our customers. We do this both in-person and through our digital omni-channel experiences. If you're someone who embraces change, is authentic, and wants to make an impact this is the place for you.

**About the Opportunity:**

FASHIONPHILE is looking for a Brand Marketing Coordinator to bring precision, follow-through, and creative energy to how our brand shows up in the physical world and alongside the people who champion it. This role sits on the Brand team and owns two connected mandates: running the FASHIONPHILE Archive Tour end to end, and building and managing brand partnerships and talent relationships that elevate FASHIONPHILE's reputation in the luxury resale space. It is a highly cross-functional, detail-obsessed role for someone who wants ownership over a visible, always-on piece of the brand calendar.

**Why This Role:**

This is a builder's role. You'll have visible ownership of one of FASHIONPHILE's most consistent brand touchpoints, direct exposure to Creative, Procurement, Retail, and Brand leadership, and a clear runway to grow into broader partnerships and project management scope.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

**FASHIONPHILE Archive Tour – 30%**

* Own end-to-end planning and execution of the touring Archive Pop-up, 12–14 activations per year, from concept through breakdown.
* Partner with Creative on pop-up design, assets, and in-store experience.
* Partner with Procurement on assortment planning and inventory logistics for each stop.
* Partner with Retail on venue logistics, staffing, and on-site activation execution.
* Serve as the single point of coordination across all stakeholders, keeping timelines, budgets, and deliverables on track for every stop on the tour.

**Brand Partnerships – 30%**

* Prospect, pitch, and secure partnerships that elevate FASHIONPHILE's brand positioning and reach.
* Guide each partnership in meticulous detail from concept through full marketing execution, owning follow-through end to end.
* Manage partnership campaigns with the rigor of a project manager: timelines, deliverables, stakeholder alignment, and reporting.

**Influencer & Talent Loans 20%**

* 2–4+ years in brand marketing, activations, partnerships, or experiential events, ideally in luxury, fashion, or retail.

The Account Manager, Enterpriseis a high-impact, revenue-driving role responsible for managing and growing Grubhub’s most valuable enterprise-level brand and merchant portfolios. This role blends top-tier relationship management with consultative selling, focusing heavily on driving merchant growth through tailored advertising, co-marketing strategies, and innovative product adoption.

Operating with a high degree of autonomy, you will act as a strategic consultant to your partners, maximizing their ROI while securing long-term retention and sustainable revenue growth for Grubhub.

**The Impact You Will Make**

Strategic Account Management & Retention

* **Portfolio Growth:** Own, protect, and scale a book of business consisting of Grubhub's highest-value enterprise accounts.

* **Healthy Advocacy:** Cultivate "client-first" relationships with senior stakeholders, confidently balancing advocacy for the merchant with Grubhub’s business interests to establish a trusted, healthy partnership.

* **Internal Liaison:** Act as a critical feedback loop, synthesising partner needs and translating them into actionable feature requests and enhancements for the internal Product and Engineering teams.

Leadership & Collaboration

* **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent practical experience.
* **Experience:** 6-10 years of experience in Enterprise Account Management, Strategic Partnerships, Ad Sales, or Digital Marketing Sales (B2B, SaaS, or Marketplace experience preferred).

At Too Good To Go, you’ll join a team that cares about developing strategic partnerships, making value-based decisions, and finding innovative solutions to the world’s food waste crisis.

**Core Responsibilities**

As a Key Accounts BDR, you are the engine behind our US expansion. This is not a passive role; you are a strategic hunter and will be tasked with breaking into national brands and large-scale franchises. You will spend 80% of your time on outreach and 20% ensuring our largest partnerships are in a position to expand. This is the definitive proving ground for future sales reps within our Key Accounts sales organization.

Proactive Business Development (80%)

jobs.title: Associate Account Manager
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.

Lyft Ads' vision is to build the largest transportation media network. We leverage media to elevate the transportation experience for our riders while building an exciting and sustainable advertising business. Our advertising opportunities include Lyft in-app homepage and in-ride products, off-platform audience extension retargeting, and IRL experiential executions. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we're looking for someone who's excited to help grow our partnerships.

As an Associate Account Manager, you'll report to the East Coast Account Management Lead and partner directly with Account Executives to plan and execute ad campaigns. You'll support campaigns from pitch through wrap, working across Sales, Ad Ops, and other teams to keep everything running smoothly. You will help improve processes and tools in order to facilitate better day-to-day operations and efficiencies for our sales team. We are looking for individuals who love solving interesting problems, are highly adaptable, and care deeply about customer satisfaction. As you grow, you'll start managing a few accounts independently and take on more direct client communication.

**Responsibilities:**
---------------------

* Pre-sales planning: Support sales team in RFP fulfillment and inventory management, including forecasting ad inventory against goals and checking takeover/events calendar.
* Data hygiene: Keep pitched and booked inventory and campaign data accurate across internal systems and CRMs.
* Post-sales execution: Own day-to-day post-sale tasks including smooth contract execution, creative services support, and campaign reporting.
* Cross-functional liaison: Coordinate with Ad Operations, Legal, Product, Engineering, and other teams to ensure all external and internal needs are adequately met.
* Ad campaign trafficking and optimization: Partner with Ad Operations to manage direct ad campaigns via internal planning tools and ad-server, including proper ticketing, set-up, scheduling, daily pacing and complete delivery based on Insertion Order parameters.
* Measurement and reporting: Build regular campaign reports and wrap reports, share insights with advertisers and internal teams, and support measurement studies where applicable.
* Billing: Coordinate with Lyft Billing at the end of each billing cycle on campaign totals and ensure invoices are generated and delivered to our advertising partners.
* Client relationships: Join the Account Executive in client and agency meetings to start building relationships, with the opportunity to take a bigger role in client conversations over time.
* Product knowledge: Learn and eventually become an expert in the full Lyft Ads product suite as well as targeting and measurement capabilities.

**Experience:**
---------------

* BA/BS degree and 2+ years of experience in digital advertising sales, media planning or campaign management.
* Proficient in Google Suite products, particularly Google Sheets and Drive.
* Exceptional communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills.
* Exhibits outstanding attention to detail.
* Excels at multitasking and is comfortable managing several campaigns throughout the ad life cycle at once.
* Strong analytical and strategic thinking, with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations for sales teams and clients.
* Consistently self-motivated and proactive in finding new solutions before being asked.
* Exposure to ad serving solutions is a plus.

**Benefits:**
-------------

* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership

Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

This role will be in-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. jobs.title: Customer Success Manager, AI Products - MCP Manager
jobs.description:
**Description**
---------------

**Location**
------------

Hybrid: New York, NY (2-3 days per week in office). The office is located in Midtown West, less than a 10-minute walk from Port Authority and under 5 minutes from Penn Station and Herald Square.

**SHAPE THE FUTURE OF AI GOVERNANCE WITH USERCENTRICS**
-------------------------------------------------------

Usercentrics is a global leader in consent management, and now we're bringing that same mission of trust and control into the AI era. MCP Manager (MCPM) is our newest product: a governance and management platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard that connects AI agents to business systems like Salesforce, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub.

As AI adoption accelerates, enterprises face a new and urgent challenge: how do you give teams the power of AI agents while maintaining visibility, security, and control over what those agents can access and do? MCP Manager is the answer, serving as the trust and control layer for AI agent connections.

This is a category-creation opportunity. MCP is being compared to the invention of the USB connector for AI: a universal standard that changes everything. We're looking for a Customer Success Manager who wants to be on the ground floor of defining what success looks like for the companies adopting it.

**THE ROLE**
------------

As our Customer Success Manager, you will own the full post-sale relationship with MCP Manager customers: onboarding, adoption, support, renewals, and expansion. Our customers are typically companies of 200 to 1,000+ employees with active AI initiatives, and the people you work with day to day include VPs of AI, CTOs, IT operations leaders, and security teams. You will be the person who makes sure every one of them gets real, measurable value from putting their AI agent connections under governance.

You will work hand in hand with our Account Executives and Sales Engineer, and closely with our product, engineering, design, and marketing teams, inside a small, fast-moving group that operates much like a startup within Usercentrics. The role exists now because our customer base is growing and customer success deserves a dedicated owner. You will build the processes, health signals, and playbooks that let us scale it, and your insight from customers will directly shape what we build next.

**YOUR TASKS**
--------------

### **Onboarding and Adoption**

* Take over new customers at handoff after signing, building on the proof of concept and documented initial configuration they completed with our Account Executive and Sales Engineer, and guide them to broad rollout across their teams.
* Refine the success criteria agreed during the sales process into a success plan for each customer that ties their use of MCP Manager to the outcomes they care about, such as visibility, security, and cost control.
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews that show customers the value they are getting and where they can go next.
* Bring in our Sales Engineer when customers need deeper help with technical configuration or troubleshooting.

### **Support and Customer Health**

* Respond to inbound support requests through chat and email within our response-time targets.
* Route technical issues to our Sales Engineer, and to engineering when needed, with clear context and reproduction steps, and keep customers informed until they are resolved.
* Build and maintain a customer health score that draws on product usage, engagement, and support history.
* Identify at-risk accounts early and lead proactive outreach before small issues become churn.

### **Renewals, Expansion, and Billing**

* Own renewals for your book of customers and forecast them accurately.
* Identify expansion opportunities, such as additional teams, servers, or plan upgrades, and drive them to close in partnership with our Account Executives.
* Process plan upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations in our billing and CRM systems so that customer records stay accurate.

### **Voice of the Customer**

* Capture and categorize customer feedback, and work with our Product Manager so that product and engineering can prioritize with real data.
* Close the loop with customers when features they requested ship or issues they reported are fixed.
* Build our customer advocacy program with marketing, collecting reviews, references, and case studies.
* Document repeatable processes and playbooks so that customer success can scale as we grow.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* You have 3 or more years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company.
* You have owned renewals for a book of business and have a track record of retaining customers and growing accounts.
* You are technically fluent: you can explain how software products connect to each other, run a confident product walkthrough, and work through configuration questions alongside technical colleagues.
* You communicate clearly in writing and in person with audiences ranging from hands-on administrators to CTOs and security leaders.
* You are highly organized and can manage many accounts, support requests, and internal projects at once without letting details slip.
* You use AI assistants and agents in your own work and are curious about how companies are adopting them.
* You are comfortable operating in an early-stage, category-creation environment where the playbook is still being written.
* Ideally, you have worked with customers in security, developer tools, data infrastructure, or AI software, or have hands-on familiarity with AI agents or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Ideally, you have built customer health scoring, onboarding programs, or other customer success processes from scratch.

  

**Benefits**
------------

* 401(k) plan contribution with employer match
* Commuter allowance (transit stipend)
* 18 paid vacation days (PTO)
* Health insurance
* Personal development budget

jobs.description:
**Role Summary**
----------------

We're looking for a strategic, creative Content Marketing Manager who knows how to build content that builds community. This isn't a role for someone who just wants to write blogs. We're looking for someone who thinks deeply about how content shapes trust, drives discovery, and turns our audience into loyal advocates. You'll own our content strategy end-to-end: building the content engine that powers our external presence and supports teams across the company, leading brand campaigns, managing our Content Marketing Coordinator, and growing the community of pros who rely on Topline Pro to run and grow their businesses. If you love building systems as much as you love crafting content that resonates with real people, and you have the portfolio to prove it, this role is for you.

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Own content strategy and the editorial calendar across website, email, social, YouTube, and community.
* Build a repeatable content engine that powers our external presence and supports cross-functional teams (sales collateral, product marketing, enablement, etc).
* Manage the Content Marketing Coordinator, setting direction while they support production and editing.
* Own our content library (DAM) so every team can easily find and use the right assets.
* Lead one-off brand campaigns, from seasonal pushes to announcements.
* Create content that speaks authentically to home service pros (roofers, landscapers, painters, cleaners) and feels uniquely Topline Pro.
* Produce a range of formats: case studies, how-to guides, video scripts, testimonials, social friendly, and long-form.
* Collect interviews oof pros and turn their stories into content that builds trust and drives organic growth.
* Use content to fuel and support growth of an engaged pro community through forums, Facebook groups, newsletters, and events.
* Build a thought leadership program for Topline Pro and key internal voices via articles, podcasts, speaking, and LinkedIn.
* Cultivate relationships with pro advocates and industry experts who amplify our brand.
* Partner with Performance Marketing to create content for paid ads.
* Develop and own a repeatable playbook for distributing content that drives sales through SEO/GEO/AEO.
* Act as a player / coach with the ability to drive direction while being comfortable jumping in to execute when needed.
* Track performance, iterate fast, and scale what resonates.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------

* 4-5 years of experience in content marketing, brand storytelling, or editorial — with a portfolio that shows range and craft.
* Experience managing and developing at least one direct report, including setting priorities and giving clear creative direction.
* Proven ability to develop content strategy, not just execute on it — you know how to build a plan, and the systems behind it, from scratch.
* Experience leading integrated brand campaigns from concept through launch.

* Track record developing thought leadership content: executive ghostwriting, contributed articles, podcast or speaking program management, or LinkedIn brand building.
* Strong writing and editing skills across formats: short-form social, long-form guides, video scripts, email sequences.
* A genuine curiosity about and empathy for small business owners — you understand their world and speak their language.
* Comfortable using data to guide decisions: you track performance, form hypotheses, and adjust accordingly.
* Experience with SEO fundamentals and content distribution, plus familiarity with GEO/AEO.
* Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, WordPress, or similar CMS, marketing automation, and digital asset management platforms.
* Collaborative instincts — you work well across brand, product, sales, and design.

**Who you are**
---------------

* A natural storyteller who can make complex or dry topics feel human and compelling.
* Someone who thinks in systems — you don't just create content, you build the machine that creates it.
* A leader who loves helping others grow — you give clear direction, great feedback, and room to run.
* Genuinely excited about community — you understand that great content is a conversation, not a broadcast, and you know how to build spaces where people want to show up.
* A natural thought leader developer — you can spot an interesting perspective in a founder or subject matter expert and shape it into something the industry actually wants to read.

* Energized by working closely with the people your content is about — you love getting on the phone with a Pro to find the real story.
* Motivated by impact and craft in equal measure.

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
Are you highly organized and thrive in a fast-paced operations environment? We are looking for a **Operations Coordinator** to coordinate daily workforce scheduling, labor allocation, credential compliance, and timekeeping processes across the organization. The Operations Coordinator plays a critical role in keeping field operations running efficiently while providing accurate labor reporting and operational support to leadership.

**The Company:**

North Shore Neon is a leading signage company with over 70 years of experience, providing design, fabrication, installation, and maintenance services throughout the New York Metropolitan region. As a privately owned and operated, design-build custom sign shop, North Shore Neon offers turnkey solutions for a wide range of signage, including custom neon, LED displays, commercial, retail, and vinyl applications.

With a team of talented and experienced individuals, North Shore Neon manages projects from concept through completion and is committed to delivering high-quality, custom signage solutions with a strong focus on craftsmanship, safety, and customer service. Learn more about us at https://www.northshoreneon.com/

**Location of Position:**

Queens, New York

**The Position:**

The **Operations Coordinator** serves as the central point of coordination between field operations, project management, and administrative teams to ensure workforce resources, equipment, and scheduling priorities are aligned with business needs. Working closely with project managers, supervisors, and leadership, this role supports operational efficiency, labor accountability, and workforce compliance while maintaining accurate scheduling, resource planning, and labor utilization data. The Operations Coordinator plays a key role in resolving resource conflicts and supporting the successful execution of projects and service work across the organization.

**Position Responsibilities:**

* Lead the daily scheduling meeting with project managers, supervisors, and department leaders.
* Prepare and distribute daily schedules, work assignments, and resource requirements.
* Resolve labor, equipment, and scheduling conflicts and communicate updates to affected staff.
* Maintain work tickets, crew assignments, and schedules in the scheduling system, ensuring accurate data for reporting and job tracking.
* Update schedules as priorities change and communicate revisions to project managers and field crews.
* Track and maintain employee certifications, licenses, and credentials, including OSHA 10/30, aerial and boom lift, forklift, electrical licenses, driver's licenses, CDLs, and site-specific badges.
* Monitor credential expiration dates and coordinate renewals and required training.
* Verify employees are properly certified and qualified before assigning work.
* Monitor employee timekeeping and work with supervisors and payroll to resolve discrepancies and maintain accurate labor records.
* Enforce company timekeeping policies and address recurring compliance issues.
* Prepare and distribute weekly labor reports showing hours by job, crew, and employee.
* Monitor overtime, labor variances, and workforce utilization trends.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED.
* Fluent in English, with strong verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Word, Outlook, PowerPoint, and Teams), Google Sheets, and other business software applications.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to communicate effectively with field personnel, supervisors, project managers, and office staff.
* Ability to maintain confidential employee and company information.
* Knowledge of construction operations and field workforce coordination is a plus.

**Desired Skills and Competencies:**

* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Ability to coordinate schedules, labor, and resources in a dynamic environment.
* Strong problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
* Ability to hold team members accountable to schedules, deadlines, and company policies.

**Why Should You Apply?**

* Leading sign company with over 70 years of industry experience and the opportunity to work on unique, high-profile, and large-scale signage projects.
* Health, Dental, Vision
* 401(k)
* Paid Time Off

The salary range for this position is $65,000 - $75,000 annually, depending on experience. The final offer will be determined based on the candidate's qualifications, relevant experience, and skills demonstrated.

**Interested?**

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetics, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected status established by federal, state, or local laws.***

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Join Us in Shaping the Future of Clinical Research**  
Adams Clinical is a leading clinical trial site network committed to accelerating the development of life-changing medicines. Our mission is simple: deliver uncompromising data quality, safety, and diverse enrollment to advance healthcare. Our vision is to set the gold standard for clinical trial excellence. We believe our people make the difference. Guided by our core values—Scientific Rigor, Operational Excellence, Commitment to Sponsors and Participants, and Authentic Collaboration—we create an environment where meaningful work drives meaningful change.

At Adams Clinical, you'll find:

* A culture of respect, transparency, and continuous improvement
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* A team dedicated to improving lives through innovation and integrity

If you're passionate about making an impact in clinical research and want to be part of a collaborative, mission-driven organization, we'd love to have you on our team.

**The Role**  
Adams Clinical is a rapidly growing research site network specializing focused on late phase industry-sponsored trials of novel treatments for a variety of psychiatric and neurological conditions, supporting both inpatient and outpatient studies.  
  
We are seeking experienced applicants for the Clinical Research Coordinator I role at our Bronx location. This role is ideal for early-career coordinators with some prior research exposure, looking to develop hands-on clinical and protocol management experience.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I is responsible for supporting and performing routine clinical research activities under the guidance of a CRC II or CRC III. The CRC I may independently manage lower-complexity trials (e.g., maintenance studies, extension studies) and serves as a secondary coordinator on high-enrolling screening trials. This role represents the first step in assuming ownership and accountability in study execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently coordinate low- to moderate-complexity trials, including scheduling, visit execution, and day-to-day operations.
* Serve as secondary CRC on high-enrolling screening trials, supporting screening, enrollment, and participant follow-up.
* Conduct participant visits per protocol, including medical/psychiatric history collection, vitals, ECGs, phlebotomy, and specimen processing, as trained.
* Prepare and maintain study source documents, lab kits, CRFs, and visit materials.
* Ensure accurate, ALCOA+-compliant documentation of all study procedures and maintain required logs, trackers, and regulatory files.
* Support investigational product (IP) accountability for assigned studies, including receipt, storage, dispensing, reconciliation, temperature monitoring, and documentation under supervision, ensuring compliance with protocol and site SOPs.
* Communicate with participants between visits to maintain engagement and protocol compliance.
* Assist with sponsor communication, monitoring visit preparation, and audit readiness as appropriate.
* Contribute to query resolution, data cleaning, and study metrics tracking to support accurate reporting and inspection readiness.
* Support screening operations and meet enrollment expectations for assigned study tasks.
* Prepare internal reports or summaries for review under guidance from CRC II/III.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* At least 6 months of prior clinical research experience. Experience with industry-sponsored clinical trials preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to continue learning hands-on clinical and research skills.

  

**Pay**: $27.00 - $33.00 per hour

**Benefits**:

* 401(k) matching
* Medical, Dental &Vision insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance

  

Adams Clinical is committed to being an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We focus on hiring and nurturing top talent. All employment decisions, including recruitment, hiring, promotion, compensation, transfer, training, discipline, and termination, are made based on the candidate's or employee's qualifications relevant to the position. These decisions are made without regard to age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, race, color, creed, religion, ethnicity, national origin, citizenship, disability, marital status, military status, pregnancy, or any other legally protected status.

In compliance with federal law, all individuals hired must, as a condition of employment, provide documentation verifying their identity and authorization to work in the United States and complete Form I-9 within the required timeframe. Adams Clinical participates in E-Verify to confirm employment eligibility.

**About Robin Hood**

Founded in 1988, Robin Hood is a 501(c)(3) public charity that finds, fuels, and creates the most impactful and scalable solutions lifting New Yorkers permanently out of poverty in New York City. We convene philanthropists, civil society organizations, government, businesses, nonprofits, community members, and those living in poverty to develop and advance programs and policies that can make the American Dream real here in New York City.

  

Our investments include best-in-class organizations providing legal services, housing, meals, workforce development training, childcare, education, and other vital services that give New Yorkers the tools to build better lives. The programs it funds are often the first of their kind and serve as demonstration models to identify what works before being replicated in other cities. Because our Board of Directors covers 100% of all administrative, fundraising, and evaluation costs, every dollar donated goes directly to organizations helping New Yorkers in need.

  

While Robin Hood's primary focus is on New York, its impact extends far beyond the borders of the city. Its pioneering, metrics-based approach has become the gold standard for charities around the nation as Robin Hood works to understand and evaluate the impact of its partners to ensure that its philanthropic dollars are utilized to maximum impact. Robin Hood also supports its community partners and their leaders with financial and strategic support and management assistance that allows those organizations to maximize their impact.

  

Robin Hood also understands that if we are to support families living in poverty on the path towards financial independence, we must become an effective partner with government. We do this by collaborating with government partners to build program and policy innovations that hold the promise of expanding economic opportunity in New York City - providing nimble "risk capital" for high-potential strategies. We also work to advance public policies that research tells us expand economic opportunity. In this way, we seek to leverage our philanthropic investments by finding ways to advance the highest-impact strategies at scale.

  

Robin Hood has the unique ability to be a catalyzing force for those living in poverty, bringing distinct constituencies together to develop and spread the most effective strategies to advance economic mobility in New York City and beyond.

  

**Our Approach:**

• **Focusing on Results** : We invest in best-in-class organizations operating effective programs. We fund research to understand how poverty persists and what strategies are effective in fighting it. And we track grant outcomes and apply cost/benefit analyses to ensure every dollar we invest demonstrably improves the lives of low-income New Yorkers.

  

• **Building Institutions that Transform New York City** : We offer management advice, strategic real estate consulting, board placement services, financial and communications coaching, leadership development, and other technical assistance to help our partners increase scale and impact.

  

• **Driving Innovation to Solve Unmet Needs** : We invest in new leaders, new organizations, and new ideas that have groundbreaking potential.

  

• **Scaling What Works:** We partner with government and other funders to grow proven solutions in New York City and beyond, so more people benefit from investments that work.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant, Events & Logistics Lead, Phoenix Deployment
jobs.description:
Job ID: 530508

CRH's Americas Materials division is the leading integrated supplier of aggregates, asphalt, ready mixed concrete and paving and construction services in North America. Our operations span North America with over 29,000 employees at close to 1,660 locations in 45 US States and 2 Canadian provinces.

  

**Job** **Summary**

CRH Americas Materials currently has ~15 different ERP systems (from two separate software vendors - SAP and Viewpoint) and is on a transformational journey, named Project Phoenix, to move to a single ERP environment (SAP) with standardized business processes across the company. This will be a multi-year program with complex change management and implementation plans. The transformation includes the integration or retirement of a full suite of approximately 30 legacy applications spanning finance, operations, safety, HR, environmental, and other functional areas as those business processes move onto SAP S/4HANA.

The Executive Assistant, Event & Logistics Lead plans and supports in-person events for Project Phoenix. Reporting to the VP, Assistant GM, Phoenix Deployment for the project, this role coordinates logistics for training, testing and validation meetings held in multiple waves across multiple locations in the US and Canada. The role will also support the Phoenix team with administrative needs between events.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, budget conscious and comfortable managing large groups, multiple vendors and last-minute changes. Exceptional attention to detail is critical to success in this role.

This is a project-based role with travel of 50% or more.

.

**Job Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Logistics

  

* Plan and coordinate in person events from start to finish, including training, testing and validation sessions.
* Source and manage hotels, venues, catering, AV and other vendors, and coordinate contract review and approval.
* Manage hotel room blocks, meeting space and event materials such as name badges, signage and supplies.
* Provide onsite support during events, including setup, check in and issue resolution.
* Partner with IT and AV teams to make sure technology is ready for each event.

Attendee Management & Communications

  

* Maintain accurate attendee lists and manage registration, confirmations and follow up.
* Partner with Business Unit leaders to confirm attendee lists and coordinate changes.
* Draft and send attendee communications, including invitations, logistics details, agendas and reminders.

Budget & Administration

  

* Track event spending against budget and look for ways to reduce costs.
* Review and process vendor invoices and expenses accurately and on time.

Project Phoenix Team Support

  

* Support the Project Phoenix team with administrative needs.
* Manage calendars and schedule meetings and calls, including recurring team meetings and calls with Business Unit leaders and consulting partners.
* Arrange team meals, catering and working lunches as needed.
* Work with other assistants across CRH to coordinate schedules, meetings and events.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Identify and plan all business activities for each value stream related to technical cutover for assigned deployment waves.
* Work with the Data and Solutions Team to confirm technical readiness for business activities, including the SAP solution and integrated applications.
* Help the business execute the cutover checklist and track readiness status as the team approaches go-live.
* Engage directly with the business to provide direction and support for cutover activities.
* Support war room operations, including issue logging, triage, and status reporting during cutover windows.
* Monitor plan through SAP ramp up and start of Crawl, Walk, Run business processes.
* Maintain cutover documentation and provide regular status updates to the Business Readiness & Cutover Lead.
* Coordinate with project managers on testing, data migration, IT system cutover, and legacy business process transition activities.
* Document the cutover plan for assigned applications/workstreams, including dependencies and data readiness requirements.
* Plan the physical and virtual resources required for cutover activities and support legacy system shutdown coordination.
* Performs additional job duties as assigned by management.

**Qualifications**

  

* High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree preferred.
* Five or more years of executive administrative or event planning experience, including events of 100+ attendees.
* Experience negotiating and managing hotel, venue and vendor contracts.
* Experience managing budgets and invoicing.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams).
* Experience with Concur travel and expense preferred.
* Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to handle confidential information with discretion.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, adapt to last-minute changes and work both independently and as part of a team.
* Professional presence and the ability to work with executives, consultants and vendors.

**Work Environment**

  

* Travel of 50% or more, often for one to four weeks at a time.
* Early mornings, evenings and occasional weekends may be required around events.
* Ability to lift and move event supplies up to 25 lbs.
* When not traveling, the role is preferred to be based in Atlanta, Georgia (TBD).

jobs.title: Aviation Warehouse Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**The Problem**
---------------

Deployments for Flock’s aviation hardware are expanding across communities as more agencies adopt drone technology. Delivering those systems reliably requires hands-on warehouse operations that turn dozens of complex sub-components into complete, field-ready hardware packages. You will keep this pipeline moving, preparing every order so field technicians have every cable, mount, and assembly ready to install out of the box.

**What You'll Own**
-------------------

* Assemble Dock 3 units and associated platform hardware to prepare each system for field deployment.
* Kit and package customer-facing orders of up to 50 individual SKUs, including specialized cables, mounts, and accessories, with precise attention to detail.
* Manage inbound and outbound logistics by receiving shipments, staging materials, and coordinating timely freight handoffs.
* Maintain accurate stock records by serializing all received aviation hardware and conducting regular cycle counts.
* Operate warehouse equipment safely, including forklifts and pallet jacks, to stage inventory and maintain an organized workspace.
* Respond promptly to tactical updates and shipping requests across internal communication channels to prevent deployment delays.

-------------------------

* This is not a specialized single-function warehouse position; you will handle receiving, assembly, kitting, inventory tracking, and shipping across the entire aviation product line.
* This is not a remote or desk role, as daily work takes place on-site in the warehouse preparing physical equipment.
* This isn't a software flashing or firmware role, as your responsibilities center on physical hardware assembly, kitting, and material movement.

* Experience working in warehouse logistics, high-volume order fulfillment, or technology hardware distribution.
* Familiarity managing a large variety of complex SKUs and multi-part hardware kits.
* Experience operating standard warehouse equipment such as forklifts and pallet jacks.
* Strong responsiveness across written communication tools like Slack and email to coordinate rapidly moving orders.

If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, email recruiting@flocksafety.com; your information stays confidential and is used only to arrange the right accommodation for your interviews.
