jobs.title: National Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Hi, I’m Brayden, co-founder of Sola. We’re a venture-backed insurance startup based in Atlanta, and we’re hiring a National Account Manager to help grow our largest agency partnerships.

Most insurance companies have spent decades building complicated products and equally complicated ways to sell them. We’re doing things differently. We started with wind and hail coverage, using weather data to make claims faster, simpler, and more transparent. We’ve grown to 8-figure revenue and partnered with thousands of independent insurance agencies along the way.

Now we’re focused on going deeper with our largest partners. Some of the biggest opportunities at Sola aren’t new relationships. They’re the agencies already doing business with us that have hundreds of producers, multiple offices, and significant room to grow.

You’ll own a named portfolio of our most important national and regional accounts, with the opportunity to build relationships, expand our footprint, and influence how Sola grows across the country.

I look forward to meeting you,

Brayden

**TL;DR Checklist**
-------------------

**✓** In person. West Midtown Atlanta office with skyline views, daily catering, and snacks

**✓** Startup environment. Small team, meaningful equity, and room to grow

**✓** Hypergrowth. 300%+ growth since May, 8-figure revenue

**✓** National accounts. Own a named portfolio of Sola’s largest agency partnerships

**✓** Real ownership. Build account strategies, expand relationships, and directly influence revenue

**✓** Flat structure. Work directly with our Director of Sales, Insurance, and leadership team

**About the Role**
------------------

* You’ll own and grow a defined portfolio of Sola’s largest national and regional agency partners. These are complex relationships that often span multiple offices, states, and decision-makers.
* Your job is to turn existing partnerships into meaningful, long-term revenue and hunt for new partnership opportunities with groups we are not yet partnered with. That means building relationships with agency leadership, identifying opportunities to expand into new offices and markets, and getting more producers actively selling Sola.
* You’ll work closely with our Sales and Insurance teams to develop account strategies, introduce new products, and help our partners grow alongside us.
* We’re looking for someone who understands how large agencies operate and knows how to turn a strong relationship into broader adoption across an organization.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------

* Own national accounts. Manage a named portfolio of large agency partners, with responsibility for revenue growth, retention, and overall account performance.
* Expand existing relationships. Identify opportunities to grow across additional offices, regions, and producer networks.
* Build strategic account plans. Develop growth strategies for each partner, set measurable goals, and execute against them.
* Drive adoption. Work with agency leadership and individual producers to make Sola a consistent part of their sales process.
* Navigate complex organizations. Build relationships with executives, regional leaders, territory managers, directors, and producers across multiple markets.
* Know your accounts. Understand agency operations, competitive offerings, and market dynamics to identify opportunities and solve problems.
* Work across teams. Partner with Sales, Insurance, and Product to introduce new programs, support agency needs, and grow existing business.

**Must-haves**

* 7+ years in sales, account management, insurance distribution, or a related field.
* Property and Casualty Insurance tenure
* Strategic account management. You’ve managed large, complex relationships and know how to grow revenue within existing accounts.
* Relationship builder.You’re comfortable working with senior executives and individual producers alike.
* Growth focused. You can identify opportunities, build a plan, and turn that plan into measurable results.
* Organized. You can manage multiple accounts, competing priorities, and long-term initiatives without losing track of the details.
* Strong communicator. You can influence decisions, navigate difficult conversations, and build trust with partners.
* In person. You’re excited to work with our team in West Midtown Atlanta.

**Strong plus**
---------------

* Multi-location growth. You’ve expanded accounts across multiple branches, territories, or states.

* Daily catered lunch

jobs.title: Route Sales & Account Manager
jobs.description:
**About Upshift**

Upshift is an on-demand staffing platform that offers Upshifters (those who work through the Upshift app) the opportunity to pick up shifts at local businesses at the touch of a button. It also allows businesses to choose from a large pool of Upshifters to find the best people available to fill their shifts. It's an incredibly user-friendly application that is revolutionizing the gig economy for businesses and for people looking for on-demand work. We are backed by Indeed.com, the world's largest job site, and are headquartered in Cincinnati.

**About This** **Job**

Upshift is looking for a Route Sales & Account Manager in Atlanta whose main job is winning new business across the metro area. You'll run a weekly route through your market, walking into businesses to open new accounts and checking in on existing clients along the way to grow them. You'll be on the road 4 days a week, and you won't be buried in paperwork: a dedicated Junior Account Manager handles scheduling issues, shift postings, client admin, and CRM cleanup while you're in the field. Your time goes to face-to-face selling. The role has a base salary plus uncapped commission on gross profit growth in your territory.

**Your Route**

* Run a set weekly or biweekly visit cadence across your assigned accounts, prioritized by revenue and risk
* Build new-business drop-ins into every route day, targeting businesses near the clients you already serve
* Log every visit, contact, and follow-up in the CRM the same day. The balance between new business and account growth will shift with the season and the needs of your territory. Some months are mostly hunting, and others are focused on growing the accounts you've built. New business is always the priority.

**New Business**

* Prospect through drop-ins, cold calls, and referrals from current clients
* Run demos of the Upshift platform and close new accounts
* Get each new client through credit and workers' comp checks and the Relationship Agreement, then hand off setup and first shift postings to your Junior Account Manager
* Hit monthly targets for new accounts and first-shift activation

**Account Growth**

* Be the senior relationship owner and in-person face for your accounts
* Expand existing clients by adding new positions, departments, and sister locations
* Lead win-back visits for dormant and declining accounts flagged by your Junior Account Manager
* Step in personally on escalations and high-stakes client issues

**Your Support**

You'll work in tandem with a Junior Account Manager who handles day-to-day client requests, shift postings, fill-rate monitoring, and CRM admin. You'll set their priorities each week and loop them in on new accounts so clients are covered while you're on your route.

**How You'll Be Measured**

* Territory gross profit against quota
* New accounts opened and activated bullet
* Weekly activity: account visits, prospect drop-ins, and demos
* Account retention and dormant-account reactivation

**Qualifications**

* 1+ years in route sales, territory sales, or field account management (route sales strongly preferred)
* Comfortable walking into a business unannounced and starting a conversation
* Organized enough to run a repeatable route and keep the CRM up to date
* Calm under pressure; can defuse a tense client situation
* Picks up new technology quickly; coachable
* Willing to pitch in beyond the job description to help the team when needed bullet Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle (mileage reimbursed)

**Employee Benefits**

***Stock***: We put our money where our mouth is. We expect everyone on our team to think like an owner, so we make them one: every employee gets stock options.

***People***: Work with talented, collaborative, and friendly people who love what they do. All resumes should be submitted in PDF or Indeed Native formats. Word resumes will not be considered.

Upshift is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, protected veteran or disabled status, or genetic information. This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

**Position Details**

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000 per year plus commission

Benefits: Dental insurance, health insurance, life insurance, mileage reimbursement, paid time off, vision insurance

Schedule: Monday to Friday; weekend availability as needed

Supplemental Pay: Commission pay, bonus pay

Ability to commute/relocate: Atlanta, GA

Experience: Route sales or territory sales: 1 year (Required); Account management: 1 year (Preferred); B2B sales or staffing industry: 1 year (Preferred)

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Work Location: On the road

jobs.description:
**About Company:**

**Build Your Future With a Company That Builds What’s Next**

At NetPlanner Systems, we don’t just keep up with technology — we help shape how organizations use it to stay ahead. As one of the Southeast’s leading providers of IT‑based solutions, we’ve spent more than 35 years delivering innovation, reliability, and the kind of service that turns clients into long‑term partners.

Our growth and success have earned us recognition as one of Georgia’s fastest‑growing middle‑market companies, a two‑time Inc. 5000 honoree, and one of Metro Atlanta’s Top 100 Workplaces. But what truly defines us isn’t the awards — it’s our people.

### **A Culture Built on Ownership, Collaboration, and Real Opportunity**

NetPlanner is a place where you can do meaningful work alongside people who genuinely care about what they do. We value curiosity, teamwork, and the drive to solve problems that matter. Our culture is built on:

* **Ownership** — As of October 31, 2025, we are 100% employee‑owned. When you join NetPlanner, you become an owner. Your ideas matter. Your work matters. And your success is tied directly to the success of the company.
* **Growth** — We invest in our people. From hands‑on learning to leadership development programs, we create pathways for you to grow your skills and your career.
* **Stability + Innovation** — With decades of proven performance and a forward‑thinking mindset, we offer the rare combination of long‑term stability and cutting‑edge opportunity.
* **Community** — We’re big enough to make an impact, but small enough that you’ll know the people you work with. Collaboration isn’t a buzzword here — it’s how we operate every day.

### **Why NetPlanner? Because Your Work Should Mean Something**

When you join us, you’re not just filling a role — you’re contributing to a company where your work has real impact and your future grows right alongside ours. You’ll be part of a team that celebrates wins together, supports each other, and takes pride in delivering excellence.

If you’re looking for a place where you can build a career, make a difference, and be part of something bigger, we’d love to meet you.

**About the Role:**

The Logistics Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient and timely movement of goods throughout the warehouse. This position is responsible for coordinating all aspects of logistics operations, including inventory management, warehousing, shipping, and receiving activities. The successful candidate will work closely with suppliers, carriers, and internal teams to optimize transportation routes and warehouse utilization, minimizing costs while maintaining high service levels. They will also monitor shipment schedules, resolve any logistical issues, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Ultimately, the Logistics Coordinator ensures that products are delivered accurately and on time, supporting overall business objectives and customer satisfaction.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain management, or related field preferred.
* Proven experience in logistics coordination, warehouse management, or a similar role.
* Strong knowledge of shipping and receiving procedures and regulations within the United States.
* Proficiency with logistics software and inventory management systems.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in logistics or supply chain management (e.g., APICS, CSCMP).
* Experience with transportation management systems (TMS) and warehouse management systems (WMS).
* Familiarity with customs regulations and international shipping processes.
* Ability to analyze data to improve logistics processes and reduce costs.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and monitor the entire order cycle to enhance business development and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Manage warehouse operations including inventory control, stock replenishment, and space optimization.
* Schedule and track shipments, liaising with carriers and freight companies to ensure timely delivery.
* Maintain accurate records of shipping and receiving activities, including documentation and compliance with regulations.
* Identify and resolve logistical problems, such as delays or discrepancies, proactively communicating with relevant stakeholders.

**Skills:**

The required skills in logistics management, warehouse management, warehousing, and shipping and receiving are applied daily to coordinate and streamline the flow of goods from suppliers to customers. The Logistics Coordinator uses logistics management skills to plan and execute transportation strategies that reduce costs and improve delivery times. Warehouse management and warehousing skills are essential for maintaining accurate inventory levels, organizing storage space efficiently, and ensuring smooth receiving and dispatching operations. Shipping and receiving expertise enables the coordinator to handle documentation, compliance, and communication with carriers effectively. Preferred skills such as proficiency with logistics software and certifications enhance the ability to analyze data, optimize processes, and adapt to evolving supply chain challenges.

**Physical Requirements:**

The physical demands described here represent those that must be met to successfully perform the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made for individuals with disabilities. The employee must be able to stand, walk, bend, kneel, squat, and climb for extended periods. The employee must also be able to lift, carry, push, and pull up to 50 pounds on a regular basis.

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (Atlanta, GA)
jobs.description:
**Sales Development Representative (Atlanta, GA)**

You don't pay us. We pay you.

SV Academy is hiring Sales Development Representatives. This is a full-time job that includes free sales training, a 90-day paid Residency at a partner company, and a clear path to a long-term sales role at one of our 400+ partner companies.

Cohorts begin every week and are limited to 25 Residents. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.

**Compensation**

* Days 1–10 — Free sales training. No tuition, no fee, no debt. Live, instructor-led training on Zoom, Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT).
* Days 11–100 — Paid Residency. $2,500/month base + 100% of the commissions you earn. You'll be a W-2 employee of SV Academy, embedded at a partner company.
* Day 100 onward — Transfer to the partner's payroll. $50k - $90k in total annual compensation (base + commission). Full health, dental, vision, and retirement benefits begin the day you transfer to the partner.

No tuition. No loans. No deferred-income agreement.

We're paid out of the hiring budget the partner was already going to spend — which means our incentive is to make you successful in the role!

**How the 100 Days Work**

**Days 1–10** — Free sales training. Ten days of live, instructor-led training. Monday through Thursday, 6–9 pm (ET or PT), on Zoom. No cost to you. You'll learn the fundamentals of B2B sales: outbound calls, email and LinkedIn outreach, objection handling, qualification, CRM and sales engagement tools (Salesforce or HubSpot, Outreach or Salesloft, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator).

**Days 11–100** — Paid Residency at a partner company. You'll work full-time at one of our partner companies as a W-2 employee of SV Academy. Real sales work: outbound prospecting via phone, email, and LinkedIn; qualifying inbound leads; scheduling discovery meetings for Account Executives. You'll get daily coaching from an SV Academy mentor and from the partner's sales leadership.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

**About SV Academy**

Since 2017, we've placed more than 6,000 people into full-time tech sales careers and worked with 400+ employer partners across SaaS, AI, fintech, cybersecurity, and other high-growth verticals.

Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt-free pathways into tech careers.

Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.

**Who Tends to Succeed Here**

No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals
* Comfortable on the phone, including cold calls
* Coachable — you take feedback and act on it
* Resilient — sales involves rejection, and you can keep going
* Strong written and spoken communicators

If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

**What Happens After You Apply**

* Apply through this posting — takes about 3 minutes.
* We respond within 2 business days. If you're a fit, we'll set up a 20-minute intro call.
* Cohort placement. If you move forward, we'll match you with a partner company and a start date. Cohorts begin every Monday and are limited to 25 Residents — apply early for priority consideration.

**Apply today.** The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first-reviewed basis.

 **Requirements**  

### **Required Qualifications:**

* English proficiency sufficient for professional work communication
* Permanently authorized to work in the United States without sponsorship
* Ability to attend evening sessions during the 2-week bootcamp

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Completed Bachelors degree
* Experience in a customer-facing role such as retail, hospitality, customer support, fundraising, or account management
* Experience in a goal-driven role with measurable targets (quotas, KPIs, bookings, revenue, or activity metrics)
* Confident and engaging communicator
* Excited by ambitious goals and motivated by a high-performance environment

  
**Benefits**  

* Professional development through SV Academy's bootcamp and ongoing training

* Paid residency placement opportunity with high-growth employer partners at a SaaS organization
* Collaborative team environment focused on growth and mentorship
* Hybrid work environment in the Atlanta, GA area with opportunities for in-person collaboration
* Professional development and mentorship from experienced sales leaders
* Potential for full-time placement with partner companies upon successful completion of the program
* Access to a supportive alumni network and ongoing career resources
* Health insurance and retirement benefits aligned with industry norms for entry-level roles

The Retail Sales Representative (RSR) is responsible for plans and activities leading to achievement of sales quotas within his/her respective retail channel and geographic territory. As a part of the Retail Sales Team, the RSR will operate at the forefront of our strategy to manage and grow the relationships with key retail partners including Lowe's and Home Depot. Individuals applying for this role need to have strong time management skills, be self-motivated, competitive, resilient, and able to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  
**1. Retail Display Maintenance:** Maintain and update retailer product displays, adding new products, additional SKUs and re-balancing inventory when necessary. Must keep displays, full, clean and neat. Before and after pictures to be submitted to supervisor.
  
**2. Sales & Performance Monitoring:** Monitor retail sales performance to identify opportunities for product placement and merchandising execution improvements. Provide feedback to the sales and management teams on sales execution productivity.
  
**3. Relationship Building & Retail Support:** Foster positive relationships with store managers and retail staff to ensure product visibility and effective merchandising execution. Serve as the main point of contact for product and brand expertise to build sustaining relationships with influential decision makers.
  
**4. Training & Incremental Orders:** Educate retail key decision makers on product features, benefits, and brand positioning to drive incremental sales orders on new and existing product categories.
  
**5. In-Store Promotion & Events:** Implement promotional sales strategies by ensuring corporate designed POP sales materials are properly executed and support special sales events or product demonstrations.
  
**6. Retail Analytics Reporting:** Track and report key retail metrics, including sales data, inventory movement, and promotional effectiveness, to help optimize sales strategies. Use insights to improve the in-store customer experience and drive sales growth.
  
**7. Professional Communication:** Drives effective communication and collaboration within the organization. Fosters good working relationships among team members and other functional contacts.
  
**8. Additional Responsibilities:** Performs all other duties as assigned.
  
This role includes a company-provided vehicle, allowing employees to effectively manage their territory and customer visits.
  
  
Job Qualifications
  

* Bachelor's Degree

Regularly required to stand, walk or sit; use hands to grasp, handle or feel objects, tools or controls; use fingers to touch, pick or pinch objects; reach with hands and arms; push or pull; climb stairs; balance; stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl; use foot or leg controls; talk or hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move objects up to 50 pounds. For all jobs no one should lift over 50lbs on their own. * Teamwork

**Title:** Social Media Specialist  
**Region:** Chicago, US – Midwest Region  
**Salary:** $75,000 - $80,000 USD Annual  
**Location:** On-site

**About Vos Collection**

Vos Collection is a network of North America's premier medical aesthetics clinics, bringing together 32 distinct clinic brands under a unified vision of elevated patient care and premium brand experiences. We are building a category-defining aesthetic brand, one that combines the intimacy and expertise of individual clinic identities with the scale and ambition of an industry-leading brand.

We believe that world-class patient experiences, high clinical standards, and modern marketing capabilities belong together. We are building the infrastructure, the brand, and the team to make that real.

**The role**

Vos Collection is seeking a research-minded writer and content creator to join our growing team as a full-time Social Media Specialist. This role sits at the intersection of science, storytelling, and social media. Your core job is to research, write, and develop content that builds and protects the professional reputation of one of the most respected voices in facial aesthetics.

If you can read a peer-reviewed study, find the story in it, and turn it into a script, an article, and a Reel that people actually want to watch, we want to hear from you. A background in journalism, publishing, or editorial work, paired with hands-on social media experience, is ideal.

**Working with Dr. Dayan**

You will work directly with Dr. Dayan, a facial plastic surgeon in Chicago whose career spans surgery, academia, and publishing. He is a New York Times and USA TODAY bestselling author, with over 180 published journal articles and six books.

Your mission is to establish Dr. Dayan as the authoritative "Science of Attraction" expert: translating rigorous science into content that is compelling, accessible, accurate, and unmistakably luxe. You will partner closely with the Regional Marketing Manager, who defines the overarching strategy, and with Dr. Dayan's surgical coordinator and clinical team, so that every piece of content ladders up to broader practice goals.

**Responsibilities**

Research and writing are the foundation of this role. Everything you produce, publish, and manage across platforms starts with finding, understanding, and writing about the science behind Dr. Dayan's work.

1. Research and thought leadership (core focus)

* Research peer-reviewed studies, journals, and literature on facial aesthetics, skin science, beauty science, and the science of attraction.
* Build and maintain a working library of sources, studies, and talking points that supports Dr. Dayan's areas of expertise.
* Synthesize complex scientific findings into clear, accurate, engaging narratives for broad audiences, and cite sources properly.
* Fact-check all content for clinical accuracy and review it with Dr. Dayan before publishing.
* Identify story angles, news hooks, and emerging research that keep Dr. Dayan at the front of the conversation in facial aesthetics.
* Develop thought leadership materials (articles, op-eds, talking points, and educational series) that strengthen Dr. Dayan's professional reputation, and support their distribution to the broader Vos Collection channels.

2. Long-form writing and editorial

* Research, write, and publish one article weekly on The Social Skin Substack, and cross-post to LinkedIn with appropriate formatting and commentary.

Unlike ad networks or signage companies, Atmosphere is the only true TV company whose first priority is to entertain television audiences outside of the home. Our content is designed to be fun, engaging, and worth watching, transforming waiting rooms, gyms, bars, and restaurants into better experiences for customers and better businesses for owners.

We are the first and only company to think about both the business owner and their customers when creating TV content. With 55,000+ venues and a global audience of over 150 million monthly viewers, Atmosphere is redefining what TV means outside the living room.

**About the role**

We’re seeking a Key Account Manager, reporting to the VP of Distribution Partnerships, to grow Atmosphere’s network of bars, restaurants, and other venues across Chicago. You’ll sign new venues from a curated list of high-value targets and make sure our most important existing customers are getting full value from the service.

This is a territory-based role that balances new business with retention, and your success will be measured on both: new customer sign-ups and how well you keep and grow the accounts you already have.

**What you'll do**

* Identify, engage, and sign new bars, restaurants, and other venues in the Chicago territory, working from a curated list of high-value targets.
* Build and maintain relationships with venue owners, managers, and other decision-makers, positioning Atmosphere as a must-have service for their venue.
* Turn signed venues into active partners who collaborate with Atmosphere on campaign executions, product sampling, and deeper integration into their concept.
* Manage a book of high-value existing customers, making sure they’re actively using the service and have it set up to fit their venue.
* Onboard and train new customers, and provide ongoing technical support so their Atmosphere setup runs smoothly.
* Spot opportunities to add value within existing accounts, such as additional screens, locations, or partnership programs.
* Keep track of Chicago hospitality trends, competitors, and new venue openings that could become targets.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly goals for new customer sign-ups, account retention, and revenue growth.
* Partner with marketing, product, and customer support to resolve customer issues and pass along client feedback that informs new features.
* Track and report sales activity, pipeline, and customer engagement metrics in the company’s CRM.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field preferred.
* Sales experience, ideally selling into hospitality, entertainment, or technology businesses.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, including pitching owners and managers face to face.
* Ability to manage a territory independently, plan your own outreach, and hit goals without day-to-day oversight.
* Experience with CRM software (Salesforce preferred) and comfort using pipeline and account data to decide where to spend your time.
* Track record of building long-term relationships with a wide range of clients.
* Ability to build a book of business from a target list and grow it over time.
* Willingness to travel throughout the Chicago territory for in-person client meetings.
* Familiarity with the Chicago bar and restaurant scene is a plus.

**Compensation & Benefits:**

* Base salary $70,000 per year
* On-target earnings $90,000 per year
* Company Equity
* Company 401(k) with employer matching
* Competitive insurance plans
* Flexible Time Off Policy

**Our Commitment to Diversity:**

**Don’t meet every single requirement?** Research shows that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet all the criteria. At Atmosphere, we’re committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where creativity, innovation, and teamwork thrive. If you’re excited about this role but your experience doesn’t perfectly align with every qualification, we still encourage you to apply—you might be the right fit for this or another role.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative (BDR)
jobs.description:
**About Climb**
===============

Climb is an AI-native Data & AI consultancy and Databricks partner. We help healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance companies get data and AI projects out of pilot and into production. Instead of large consulting teams, we staff small, senior engineering pods on fixed-scope engagements that reach production in 8 to 12 weeks.

We build long-term partnerships with the data teams we work with, and we grow our people the same way: through direct mentorship from founders and senior architects and real exposure to enterprise deals from day one.

**Role Summary**
================

We're looking for a Business Development Representative to open new accounts for Climb across regulated industries. You'll research companies running on Databricks or evaluating it, find the business problems their data teams are stuck on, and start conversations with the people who own them. You'll pair directly with a senior member of Climb’s GTM team and work alongside our solution architects and Databricks account teams on every pursuit, and you'll see how enterprise consulting deals are scoped and won.

We don't have a big-brand inbound engine. Every meeting we book comes from someone who found the right account, figured out who owned the problem, and started a real conversation.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

* Drive new-logo acquisition across healthcare, life sciences, financial services and insurance accounts.
* Build and manage pipeline through outbound prospecting across phone, email and LinkedIn, plus referrals and industry events.
* Plan and run account-based campaigns into named target accounts, coordinated with marketing and your Databricks counterparts.
* Build relationships across data, IT, compliance and executive leadership, and understand who decides what.
* Identify business challenges and translate them into data, analytics and AI opportunities our architects can scope.
* Run discovery on early-stage opportunities and co-run deals alongside your sales partner.
* Co-sell with Databricks account teams on shared accounts in your territory, and run a recurring sync with your assigned Databricks account executives and partner managers.
* Collaborate with solution architects and delivery leads to shape winning pursuits.
* Travel to represent Climb at client meetings, Databricks events, industry forums and Climb-hosted workshops.
* Track your activity and results, and help shape the playbook as we grow.

**What Success Looks Like**
===========================

* **30 days:** You know our offerings and target accounts, and you've met your Databricks counterparts and set a recurring sync with each.
* **60 days:** You're booking qualified meetings you sourced yourself every week.
* **90 days:** You're consistently hitting your pipeline target and have contributed to at least one active opportunity.
* **6 months:** You're at full pipeline target, running discovery on your own, and co-running opportunities with your GTM partner.

**Required Qualifications**
===========================

* 2+ years in a BDR or SDR seat, with a track record of meetings you sourced yourself, not just inbound follow-up.
* Experience selling to technical, IT or data buyers. Backgrounds in data infrastructure, cloud, developer tools or technical recruiting are a strong fit.
* Comfort with cold calling and hunting for contacts, and the ability to explain why you went after an account and why you started with the person you did.

Role:

**About the Role**

Behind every well-organized department is someone who knows how to connect the details, anticipate what's needed, and keep important priorities moving. As the Administrative Coordinator at Southland Credit Union, you'll provide high-level administrative and operational support to our SVP of People & Culture while helping coordinate the projects, communications, and initiatives that support the broader department.

This role combines executive-level administrative support with presentation development, communications, and project coordination. You'll help manage priorities, prepare materials for leadership discussions, organize departmental activities, and ensure important follow-ups don't get lost. Your ability to exercise sound judgment, work independently, and bring structure to complex details will make you an important resource to the People & Culture team.

  
Major Duties and Responsibilities:

**Supporting Leadership and Keeping Priorities Moving**

You'll work closely with the SVP of People & Culture to manage schedules, coordinate meetings, prepare agendas, organize leadership materials, and ensure discussions and follow-up items stay on track. You'll also draft and format correspondence, reports, and professional documents while maintaining organized departmental records and resources.

Being effective in this role means knowing how to look ahead. You'll anticipate administrative needs, navigate scheduling conflicts, manage competing priorities, and use good judgment when handling sensitive employee and organizational information. From coordinating appointments to tracking outstanding assignments, your organization and follow-through will help keep departmental priorities moving.

**Turning Information Into Clear, Professional Communications**

You'll use your organizational and creative skills to develop polished, executive-ready presentations, reports, and supporting materials for leadership discussions, departmental meetings, employee training, and organizational initiatives. You'll take information and data and translate them into clear, visually engaging materials that communicate priorities, support decision-making, and keep others informed.

You'll also help shape how People & Culture communicates with associates. This includes preparing employee announcements, newsletters, departmental updates, and informational resources, as well as creating presentation templates and maintaining SharePoint pages and intranet content. Whether you're preparing materials for a leadership discussion or helping communicate an employee initiative, accuracy, thoughtful presentation, and attention to detail matter.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

We seek a reliable and compassionate CHW to provide CHW and ECM services and conduct consistent Community Outreach to clients in the community. As a CHW, you will play a vital role in improving the health and well-being of individuals.

You will work closely with patients, families, and healthcare providers to deliver high-quality, patient-centered care that addresses the physical, emotional, and social needs of our clients. This position will assist in connecting individuals with health and community support services, playing a crucial role in helping people access the care and resources they need directly. The role involves providing CHW or ECM Services on the spot and conducting outbound calls to connect clients to resources.

**Responsibilities:**

**CHW/ ECM Services:**

1. Conduct patient assessments to identify health and social needs.

2. Develop personalized care plans in collaboration with patients, families, and healthcare providers.

3. Provide education and support on chronic disease management, healthy behaviors, and self-care.

4. Facilitate access to community resources, services, and referrals.

5. Coordinate care transitions and communicate with healthcare providers.

6. Conduct regular home visits and phone follow-ups to monitor progress and ensure ongoing support.

7. Document patient interactions and care plans in the electronic health record within 24 hours, and close all encounters.

8. Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to address patient needs and improve health outcomes.

9. Identify and address social determinants of health and health disparities.

10. Provide cultural competency and linguistically appropriate services.

11. Maintain patient confidentiality and adhere to HIPAA guidelines.

12. CHW minimum productivity is expected to be 80% clinical (patient billable encounters) and 20% Non-productive (driving/documentation/outreach, etc.).

13. Schedule 75% of clients before the 15th of each month.

14. Conduct outreach for community awareness of the ECM program.

15. Attend regular staff meetings, training sessions, and other meetings as requested.

16. Minimum caseload of 25-30 ECM clients, and may increase during times when the clinic is experiencing a staffing shortage.

17. Minimum combined total of 20 CHW and ECM touches per month.

**Community Outreach:**

1. Initially, outbound calls will be made to individuals on the assigned referral lists to educate them regarding CHW and ECM services available to them under their health plan.

a. Insurance must be verified before services can be provided to ensure the client is eligible.

b. If the client’s need is minimal and can be addressed in the short term, a CHW touch will be conducted on the spot, such as providing resources or navigating a website.

c. If the client’s need is extensive and requires a long-term plan to achieve their goals, an ECM intake/successful engagement will be conducted on the spot.

2. Engage members in a respectful, culturally sensitive, and trauma-informed manner.

3. Accurately document outreach activity using standardized tracking systems, designated outreach platforms, and Dr. Cloud.

4. Track member responses, time spent, and follow-up needs in accordance with approved program procedures.

5. Schedule intake appointments and ensure appropriate follow-up to confirm member engagement.

6. Follow internal workflows for outreach outcomes.

7. Confirm appointment attendance and relay updates to care and coordination teams as needed.

8. Identify and escalate issues such as insurance discrepancies, invalid contact information, urgent support needs, or language barriers.

9. Participate in regular team meetings, compliance training, and performance reviews.

**NON-ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:** Performs other duties as assigned. Ability to work independently and be self-directed and flexible. Ability to perform functions with minimal supervision. Ability to work at a high-volume level of accuracy.

**Requirements:**

1. A bachelor's degree in psychology, social work, human services, or a related field.

2. Community-based work, also known as in-vivo work, requires proper safety precautions.

3. Certification as a CHW (CCHW) or willingness to obtain within 18 months.

4. CPI and CPR within 30 days of hire.

5. Strong communication, interpersonal, and cultural competency skills.

6. Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

7. Basic computer skills and familiarity with electronic health records.

8. Valid driver's license and reliable transportation (if applicable).

**Preferred Qualifications:**

1. Certified as a CHW (CCHW)

2. Experience working with diverse populations and communities.

3. Knowledge of community resources and services.

4. Familiarity with care management software and technology.

5. Bilingual or multilingual skills.

**Working Conditions:**

1. Office and Community setting with frequent travel to client homes, community organizations, and healthcare providers.

2. Flexible scheduling to accommodate client needs, including evenings and weekends.

**We Offer:**

1. Competitive salary and benefits package.

2. Opportunities for professional growth and development.

3. Collaborative and supportive work environment.

4. The chance to make a meaningful difference in the lives of our patients and community

new_jobs.description:
Do you take real pride in the craft of operational leadership — the kind that makes complex enterprise relationships feel effortless to the customer and unlocks the growth teammates can see but not always reach? Are you the person who anticipates issues before they surface, orchestrates internal resources with quiet mastery, and gets satisfaction from making the machine work? **If your answers are yes, please read on.**

As a **Strategic Account Manager (SAM)** at Pacific Rim Capital (PRC), you will be the day-to-day operational owner for a portfolio of PRC's most important Fortune 500 relationships. You will ensure existing business is flawlessly executed, coordinate internal resources across the company, build strong operational relationships with customer stakeholders, and partner with senior sales colleagues on account strategy — all in service of retention, portfolio performance, and continued customer growth.

This role offers a competitive base salary plus commission tied to account performance.

Our ideal candidate is a senior operations professional — detail-oriented, judgment-driven, and genuinely energized by the work of running complex accounts well. You are an exceptional listener, a trusted internal orchestrator, and someone who takes the customer experience personally.

**About the Role**

PRC is one of North America's largest *independent* providers of equipment financing and leasing solutions, with nearly $2 billion in assets under management. We finance material handling equipment (MHE), IT, warehouse automation, energy, and over-the-road vehicles for Fortune 500 clients across the U.S., Canada, and Mexico.

**Reporting to the VP of Asset Strategy, you will:**

  

* **Own operational execution —** serve as the day-to-day operational owner for assigned strategic accounts, ensuring a consistent, high-quality customer experience across every interaction.
* **Manage flow business end-to-end —** coordinate funding requests, lease administration, renewals, and portfolio activities on established customer programs.
* **Coordinate internal resources —** orchestrate work across PRC's sales, remarketing, opportunity management, lease administration, financial operations, and customer success functions to ensure seamless execution and timely issue resolution.
* **Build operational relationships —** develop strong working relationships with customer operations, procurement, finance, fleet, and facility stakeholders that strengthen day-to-day engagement.
* **Anticipate customer needs —** monitor utilization trends, upcoming capital projects, lease maturities, and portfolio performance to stay ahead of what the customer will need next.
* **Lead operational and business reviews —** run account reviews, operational business reviews, and portfolio performance discussions, providing customers with actionable recommendations to improve fleet performance and total cost of ownership.
* **Improve continuously —** identify opportunities to improve program efficiency, customer satisfaction, and portfolio performance through process improvements and operational recommendations.
* **Partner with sales on account strategy —** work closely with senior sales colleagues to execute account strategies that increase retention, expand PRC's footprint within the customer, and strengthen PRC's strategic position.
* **Maintain institutional memory —** keep comprehensive account plans, relationship maps, and customer activity records that support continuity, visibility, and effective succession planning.

  

**What Success Looks Like**

  

We do not leave success to guesswork. Here is the ramp:

**First 30 days.** Complete onboarding on PRC's products, asset classes, CRM, and pricing tools. Meet the VP of Asset Strategy, your sales colleagues, the internal partners you'll coordinate with, and key customer operational stakeholders on each assigned account. Absorb the account plan, program documentation, funded transaction history, and current portfolio position for every assigned account.

**3 months.** You are the day-to-day operational owner — the customer's routine requests, program flow, and administration are running smoothly through you. Regular correspondence cadence with client contacts is established. First operational business review or QBR delivered.

**6 months.** Operational excellence is the customer's experience — responsive, accurate, low-friction. You've surfaced at least one operational recommendation that improved program efficiency or portfolio performance. Risk indicators (competitive threats, org changes, declining engagement) are being surfaced early to your sales partners.

**9 months.** Account plans, relationship maps, and activity records are current and comprehensive. Regular cadence of QBRs and portfolio performance reviews is established with every assigned account, delivering actionable TCO and fleet-performance recommendations.

**12 months.** Assigned accounts show measurable improvement in retention, portfolio performance, and customer satisfaction. Your sales partners feel supported and unburdened; your customers feel operationally well-served. Ready to take on additional strategic accounts as capacity allows.

* A 4-year degree from an accredited college or university.
* 8-10 Senior-level experience in enterprise account management, customer success, or account operations — with a track record of owning strategic accounts at scale.

* Demonstrated ability to run complex operational execution across multiple internal functions in a large B2B environment.
* Experience leading operational business reviews or QBRs with senior customer stakeholders.
* Strong analytical skills — comfortable interpreting portfolio data, utilization trends, and lease-maturity schedules.

new_jobs.description:
Tustin, CA

H - Business – H - Business /

On-site

  

**The Company**

VeSync is a portfolio company with brands that cover different categories of health & wellness products. We wouldn't be surprised if you have one of our Levoit air purifiers in your living room or a COSORI air fryer whipping up healthy and delicious meals for you every night.

We're a young and energetic company, we've had tremendous success, and we are constantly growing our team. As we garner more industry attention — just check out our accomplishments and awards by CES Innovation, iF Design, IGA, and Red Dot — we also need driven and talented people to join our team.

That brings us to you, and what you'll be joining. Our teams are smart and diligent and take ownership of their work — they're confident in their work but know how to collaborate with open ears and a spirit of learning. If you're down-to-earth, approachable, and easy to strike up a conversation with, this may be a great fit for you.

  

**Check out our other brands**:

levoit.com | cosori.com | etekcity.com

  

**The Opportunity**

A new ecosystem at the intersection of wellness and technology, with a connected product, hardware and software, built to help people take an active role in their own health rather than simply measure it. The Social Media Manager owns the social presence behind that launch, from the first post through the audience we build.

Your job is to decide what each channel is for, build the content that fills it, and grow an audience from a standing start. You'll set the strategy and make the work, engage the people who show up, and build the credibility that turns attention into members. We are pre-launch, and the brand, the positioning, and the claims we can make are all still being built. You'll work alongside that, not after it. It's a hands-on role.

### **What you will do at VeSync:**

**Channel Strategy & Audience**

* **Own the Channel Strategy**: Define what each channel is for, the role it plays from first impression through consideration, and the goal it carries. Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, X, Threads, Reddit, and what comes next.
* **Own the Audience Build**: Grow the audience from a standing start. Audience and engagement growth are numbers you own, with an approach behind them.
* **Turn Positioning into Channel-Native Content**: Take the positioning and claims framework owned by Product Marketing and turn it into content that works on each channel, adapted rather than copied across. Both are being written now, so expect to work from drafts and adjust as they settle.

**Content & Voice**

* **Own the Calendar and the Formats**: Build the programming calendar, the repeatable formats behind it, and the production cadence that keeps it fed.
* **Make the Work**: Concept, write, shoot, edit, and publish. Creative and agency partners support you, they don't do it for you.
* **Hold the Voice and the Claims Line**: Keep a consistent brand voice across channels, and work inside the medical, regulatory, and claims review process rather than around it.

**Engagement & Performance**

* **Drive Engagement on Owned Channels**: Reply to comments, answer DMs, and take part in the conversation under our own posts. Route product issues and escalations to CX.
* **Show Up on Reddit and in Forums**: Hold our presence in the places this product gets discussed by people who know it well. These are spaces we don't control, and they reward participation over promotion.
* **Own the Numbers**: Set the metrics and KPIs for each channel, report performance honestly, and turn what the data says into what gets made next.

### **What you bring to the role:**

* **Education**: Bachelor's degree required.
* **Experience**: 5+ years managing social media for consumer (B2C) brands, with hands-on direct-to-consumer (DTC) experience. Health & wellness, consumer hardware, and subscription or membership backgrounds are strongly preferred.
* **New Brand & Audience Build**: Proven track record launching a brand, sub-brand, or product line into an audience that did not previously exist.
* **Comfortable with Ambiguity**: Can build while the brand, the positioning, and the claims framework are still being settled. Makes progress on partial information, changes direction when decisions land, and doesn't fill the gaps by inventing positioning of their own.
* **Platform Native**: Fluent in the craft and the culture of each channel and in how they differ. Comfortable in forums and communities you don't control, where publishing like a brand doesn't work.
* **Hands-On Maker**: Concepts, writes, shoots, and edits. Produces the content, not only the brief.
* **Claims & Regulatory Fluency**: Experience in health, wellness, medical device, supplements, or a similarly regulated space. Knows what to avoid, and how to say something true and interesting inside real constraints.
* **Analytical**: Sets metrics and KPIs, reads performance honestly, and uses it to decide what to make next. Able to argue engagement quality over vanity metrics and back it with evidence.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration**: Partners closely with paid social, brand and creative, product, and CX.

### **Location:**

* This is an on-site, office-based role in Tustin, CA.

### **Salary:**

* Starting at $90K Annually

### **Perks and Benefits:**

* 100% covered Medical/Dental/Vision for employee AND spouse + dependents!
* 401K with 4% employer match (eligible after 90 days of employment) and immediate vesting
* Generous PTO policy + paid holidays
* Life Insurance
* Voluntary Life Insurance
* Disability Insurance
* Critical Illness Coverage
* Accident Insurance
* Healthcare FSA
* Dependent Care FSA
* Travel Assistance Program
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Fully stocked kitchen

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Estimator / Project Coordinator prices commercial flooring and surface services work, helps win it, and then carries each awarded project from contract through closeout. This role owns the bid and the project paperwork, working closely with Operations, which manages crews and field performance, and with Accounting, which handles invoicing and collections.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Estimating and Bid Management**

* Review incoming bid invitations, accept bids, and assign them to the appropriate estimator or division.

* Prepare estimates using takeoffs, vendor quotes, and the company labor rate sheet; keep the rate sheet current.

* Request and follow up on pricing from suppliers and vendors by phone and email.

* Incorporate drive time and overtime into labor pricing.

* Prepare RFIs, manage bid deadlines, and submit complete proposals on time.

* Enter each bid in Salesforce with the client project manager’s contact information and the latest proposal.

**Contract Award Review**

* Verify that the company’s legal name, scopes of work, and dollar values on each contract match the awarded bid.

* Confirm inclusions and exclusions are clearly stated and priced, including power/generators, floor protection, floor preparation, demolition, and adhesive removal.

* Compare scheduled days and work dates against the time required to perform the work.

* Track pre-lien notices.

**Project Coordination**

* Schedule job starts and project timelines with clients and Operations.

* Review contracts in detail, route them through DocuSign as needed, and negotiate or correct changes with clients.

* Obtain contact information for each client’s project manager and superintendent.

* Obtain insurance requirements from the general contractor or contract and coordinate certificates of insurance with the company’s insurance broker.

* Prepare, submit, and track submittals and samples through approval.

* Order materials for awarded projects.

* Attend Project Labor Agreement (PLA) meetings.

* Upload budgets, contracts, and project documents to Procore.

* Collect work tags from Operations, prepare change order requests (CORs), and track them through approval.

* Maintain budgeted production rates, using closeout feedback from Operations to refine future estimates.

* Complete project closeout documentation.

**Billing Coordination**

* Notify Accounting when billing milestones are reached, including submittals sent, materials ordered, mockups completed, stages of work completed, and final completion.

**Other Duties**

* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Required**

* 3 to 5 years of estimating experience in commercial flooring, finishes, or a related trade.

* Working knowledge of takeoffs, labor productivity, and material costs.

* Ability to read and interpret contracts, scopes of work, insurance requirements, and prevailing-wage or PLA provisions.

* Proficiency with Salesforce, Procore, DocuSign, Microsoft Excel, and email.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple deadlines.

* Clear written and verbal communication with general contractors, vendors, and internal teams.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Simpro or QuickBooks.

* Procore certification or formal estimating training.

**WORKING CONDITIONS AND PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**

Work is primarily office-based, with occasional job walks and PLA meetings at active construction sites, which may require walking on uneven surfaces and wearing personal protective equipment. Bid deadlines may require extended hours during busy periods. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

new_jobs.title: Field Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Convey**
----------------

Every growing company runs on an invisible operating layer: recurring work that crosses a dozen systems and still needs a person to move it forward. Convey is a digital workforce platform. We take that work off the team and give it to digital teammates that the company's own operators train and manage. Each teammate owns a responsibility from the first request to the finished result.

Customers like TelevisaUnivision, Savoya, and Strategus use Convey for work that stands between the business and its revenue. Strategus cut integration launches from three to six months down to under one week.

**About the role**
------------------

We sell to executives, and you'll create the rooms where they meet us. You'll own Convey's field events and event speaking opportunities, and make them the in-person engine of our account-based motion: executive dinners and roundtables, our own events, and the right presence at the right industry events. Working hand in hand with sales, you'll make sure every event starts from our target accounts and ends in meetings and pipeline.

You'll also build the team differently. Alongside the core job, you'll train and manage your own digital workforce on Convey. Those teammates will own the recurring research, tracking, and follow-up work that usually takes over a field marketer's week, so your time goes to strategy, experiences, and relationships. You'll be customer zero for the product you're marketing.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

**Event strategy and budget**

* Build and own the field events plan and budget, chosen around where our target accounts and executive buyers actually gather.
* Decide where we show up and how: sponsorships, hosted side events, booths, or not at all.

**Executive and hosted events**

* Plan and run executive dinners, roundtables, breakfasts, and workshops around key industry events and in our priority markets.
* Create events we host ourselves, from small executive gatherings to customer and community events.

**Speaking opportunities**

* Source, pitch, and secure speaking slots for our executives and customers at events that reach our buyers. Partner with brand marketing on each executive's point of view and talk.
* Turn every talk into conversations with target accounts.

**Account-based execution**

* Partner with account executives and demand generation to build invite lists from target accounts, and run the outreach before each event and the follow-up after.
* Own the handoff: every attendee conversation reaches the right seller quickly, with context.

**Measurement**

* Track every event from invite to pipeline: target account attendance, meetings, and pipeline sourced and influenced. Report on it every week and cut what doesn't work.
* Keep event data clean in the CRM and marketing platforms.

**Vendors and logistics**

* Manage venues, agencies, production, swag, travel, and budgets, with the same bar for a 12-person dinner as for a 2,000-person conference.

**Your digital workforce**

* Decide which recurring field work to delegate. Examples include event research and calendars, speaking submission tracking, invite list building and account research, RSVP and logistics tracking, attendee follow-up prep, and post-event reporting.
* Train those teammates, review their work, and keep improving them as programs change.
* Share what works so it shapes how Convey markets with Convey and how we tell the story to customers.

**What you bring**
------------------

* 5+ years in field or event marketing at B2B SaaS companies with a sales-led motion that sells to enterprise executives.
* Executive events that produced meetings and pipeline, not just attendance. You can show the numbers.
* Experience running events as part of an account-based program, in close partnership with sales.
* Experience securing speaking slots and preparing speakers.
* A strong operator. You run budgets, vendors, and logistics without dropping details.
* Fluency in CRM and marketing platforms. You report on event results yourself.
* Comfort with regular travel.
* Real fluency with AI, and the urge to hand off whole processes rather than just doing pieces of them faster.
* Experience marketing AI or enterprise software platforms.

**Why join**
------------

* Build the field program for a new category from the ground up.
* Use the product to build your team. You'll know the customer's experience better than anyone.
* Help shape the marketing organization early.

Event Services Client Account Manager

**Overview**
------------

Company Overview:

Kick off your exciting career in Event Security with Allied Universal® Event Services, the go-to leader in crowd management and event staffing. Dive into the action at sports stadiums, concerts, festivals, and convention centers, and thrive on the energy of being where it all happens. Join a lively team that services thousands of venues each year, ensuring safety and fun for everyone. Enjoy the perks of a flexible work schedule that fits your lifestyle—ideal for students, retirees, or anyone seeking a dynamic job. We offer job opportunities in event staff, security, and operations. Join our welcoming, collaborative, and innovative team, and benefit from a range of perks depending on your role and hours. At Allied Universal®, every day brings a new adventure. Ready to make your mark in the event industry? Join us and be part of the excitement!

**Job Description**
-------------------

Allied Universal® is hiring a Client Account Manager. This position is responsible for the day-to-day operations and overseeing events at an assigned account in the east bay region. Account managers also build, improve, and maintain relationships with clients and employees, develop and retain staff, and coordinate needed support services and solve problems to effectively run the account and event operations. Through knowledge of the principles and practices used in successful event management, this position is responsible for show preparation up and through its closeout, while adhering to all applicable policies and procedures. Duties include the provisioning of leadership and direction to subordinate staff, supervisors, and front-line crew members while maintaining the highest levels of employee morale, safety, service, appearance, and performance.

The salary for this position is $90,000 to $100,000 annually.

**RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Supervise the day-to-day event operations and staffing of an assigned client site
* Manage a team of event supervisors and event staff including hiring/selection, scheduling, payroll, training, coaching, development and support, discipline, and terminations
* Build, improve, and maintain effective relationships with both client and employees
* Coordinate necessary support services to effectively manage client site to meet or exceed financial and operational goals and provide quality customer service
* Ensure all required reporting and contract compliance requirements are met
* Assure regular communication of issues or event with our client
* Handle any escalated security issues or emergency situations appropriately
* Communicate staffing needs via Requisition Form; assist recruiters in identifying, interviewing, and hiring quality candidates
* Develop staff in both technical and professional skills through performance management (coaching, counseling, disciplining, training, annual formal performance evaluations, recognition, etc.)
* Assure communication of policies, company announcements and job openings through a consistently updated READ file at each site
* Meet all contractual scheduled hours with a minimum of unbilled overtime
* Coordinate and/or conduct site-specific OJT, client-specific training, and annual refresher training for event security and event staff personnel, as well as meet Allied Universal’s corporate training standards
* Develop and maintain operational procedures so that a valid, site-specific post orders are always available for emergency reference by the event staff
* Manage uniforms, equipment, supplies, and vehicles utilized at the account(s), maintaining appropriate inventories and maintenance checklists
* Take a proactive role in communicating with the client and meeting their needs; meet regularly, listen to issues, provide security and technical expertise and solutions; ensure complete customer satisfaction
* Capably utilize ABI and WinTeam for scheduling and billing, and to produce reports (such as Scheduling Activity, invoice Aging by tiers, Training Summary and Training Detail reports) that require interpretation and action for effective business management
* Enforce Allied Universal Event Services policies as outlined in the handbooks, executive memos and on the portal
* Attend client meetings, security meetings, and event walk-through(s)
* Ensure all staff is debriefed properly and prepared for each event
* Prepare and disseminate event post orders to each employee working each event as assigned venue/event
* Ensure all labor laws are being adhered to (rest and meal periods executed per law, check-in/check-out procedure is followed, etc.)
* Promote Grooming and Appearance Policy by looking professional and appropriate at all times and enforcing that policy within the ranks
* Maintain constant communication with direct manager regarding client issues or concerns, employee performance issues, guest complaints, injuries, or other important facts related to account/event assigned
* Create venue dot maps deployment sheets, show grids, etc.
* Complete and submit all paperwork (incident reports, workers compensation filings, etc.) according to policy, along with the event file, to direct manager
* Oversee and maintain Core staffing, key position succession, and monitor scheduled personnel/shifts
* Facilitate the timely invoicing of events and follows up with client to ensure payment; investigate and mitigate any impediments to the invoicing and payment process in conjunction with the Finance Manager

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalent
* Licensing requirements are subject to state and/or local laws and regulations and may be required prior to employment
* Minimum of three (3) years of event management, event operations, and/or event supervisory experience
* Experience in hiring, developing, motivating, and retaining quality staff
* Ability to develop and grow customer relationships
* Ability to work in a team-oriented management environment wi

------------

As our Customer Success Manager, you will own the full post-sale relationship with MCP Manager customers: onboarding, adoption, support, renewals, and expansion. Our customers are typically companies of 200 to 1,000+ employees with active AI initiatives, and the people you work with day to day include VPs of AI, CTOs, IT operations leaders, and security teams. You will be the person who makes sure every one of them gets real, measurable value from putting their AI agent connections under governance.

You will work hand in hand with our Account Executives and Sales Engineer, and closely with our product, engineering, design, and marketing teams, inside a small, fast-moving group that operates much like a startup within Usercentrics. The role exists now because our customer base is growing and customer success deserves a dedicated owner. You will build the processes, health signals, and playbooks that let us scale it, and your insight from customers will directly shape what we build next.

**YOUR TASKS**
--------------

### **Onboarding and Adoption**

* Take over new customers at handoff after signing, building on the proof of concept and documented initial configuration they completed with our Account Executive and Sales Engineer, and guide them to broad rollout across their teams.
* Refine the success criteria agreed during the sales process into a success plan for each customer that ties their use of MCP Manager to the outcomes they care about, such as visibility, security, and cost control.
* Run regular check-ins and business reviews that show customers the value they are getting and where they can go next.
* Bring in our Sales Engineer when customers need deeper help with technical configuration or troubleshooting.

### **Support and Customer Health**

* Respond to inbound support requests through chat and email within our response-time targets.
* Route technical issues to our Sales Engineer, and to engineering when needed, with clear context and reproduction steps, and keep customers informed until they are resolved.
* Build and maintain a customer health score that draws on product usage, engagement, and support history.
* Identify at-risk accounts early and lead proactive outreach before small issues become churn.

### **Renewals, Expansion, and Billing**

* Own renewals for your book of customers and forecast them accurately.
* Identify expansion opportunities, such as additional teams, servers, or plan upgrades, and drive them to close in partnership with our Account Executives.
* Process plan upgrades, downgrades, and cancellations in our billing and CRM systems so that customer records stay accurate.

### **Voice of the Customer**

* Capture and categorize customer feedback, and work with our Product Manager so that product and engineering can prioritize with real data.
* Close the loop with customers when features they requested ship or issues they reported are fixed.
* Build our customer advocacy program with marketing, collecting reviews, references, and case studies.
* Document repeatable processes and playbooks so that customer success can scale as we grow.

  

**Requirements**
----------------

* You have 3 or more years of experience in customer success, account management, or a similar customer-facing role at a B2B SaaS company.
* You have owned renewals for a book of business and have a track record of retaining customers and growing accounts.
* You are technically fluent: you can explain how software products connect to each other, run a confident product walkthrough, and work through configuration questions alongside technical colleagues.
* You communicate clearly in writing and in person with audiences ranging from hands-on administrators to CTOs and security leaders.
* You are highly organized and can manage many accounts, support requests, and internal projects at once without letting details slip.
* You use AI assistants and agents in your own work and are curious about how companies are adopting them.
* You are comfortable operating in an early-stage, category-creation environment where the playbook is still being written.
* Ideally, you have worked with customers in security, developer tools, data infrastructure, or AI software, or have hands-on familiarity with AI agents or Model Context Protocol (MCP).
* Ideally, you have built customer health scoring, onboarding programs, or other customer success processes from scratch.

  

**Benefits**
------------

* 401(k) plan contribution with employer match
* Commuter allowance (transit stipend)
* 18 paid vacation days (PTO)
* Health insurance
* Personal development budget

**Join Us in Shaping the Future of Clinical Research**  
Adams Clinical is a leading clinical trial site network committed to accelerating the development of life-changing medicines. Our mission is simple: deliver uncompromising data quality, safety, and diverse enrollment to advance healthcare. Our vision is to set the gold standard for clinical trial excellence. We believe our people make the difference. Guided by our core values—Scientific Rigor, Operational Excellence, Commitment to Sponsors and Participants, and Authentic Collaboration—we create an environment where meaningful work drives meaningful change.

At Adams Clinical, you'll find:

* A culture of respect, transparency, and continuous improvement
* Opportunities for professional growth and learning
* A team dedicated to improving lives through innovation and integrity

If you're passionate about making an impact in clinical research and want to be part of a collaborative, mission-driven organization, we'd love to have you on our team.

**The Role**  
Adams Clinical is a rapidly growing research site network specializing focused on late phase industry-sponsored trials of novel treatments for a variety of psychiatric and neurological conditions, supporting both inpatient and outpatient studies.  
  
We are seeking experienced applicants for the Clinical Research Coordinator I role at our Bronx location. This role is ideal for early-career coordinators with some prior research exposure, looking to develop hands-on clinical and protocol management experience.

The Clinical Research Coordinator I is responsible for supporting and performing routine clinical research activities under the guidance of a CRC II or CRC III. The CRC I may independently manage lower-complexity trials (e.g., maintenance studies, extension studies) and serves as a secondary coordinator on high-enrolling screening trials. This role represents the first step in assuming ownership and accountability in study execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Independently coordinate low- to moderate-complexity trials, including scheduling, visit execution, and day-to-day operations.
* Serve as secondary CRC on high-enrolling screening trials, supporting screening, enrollment, and participant follow-up.
* Conduct participant visits per protocol, including medical/psychiatric history collection, vitals, ECGs, phlebotomy, and specimen processing, as trained.
* Prepare and maintain study source documents, lab kits, CRFs, and visit materials.
* Ensure accurate, ALCOA+-compliant documentation of all study procedures and maintain required logs, trackers, and regulatory files.
* Support investigational product (IP) accountability for assigned studies, including receipt, storage, dispensing, reconciliation, temperature monitoring, and documentation under supervision, ensuring compliance with protocol and site SOPs.
* Communicate with participants between visits to maintain engagement and protocol compliance.
* Assist with sponsor communication, monitoring visit preparation, and audit readiness as appropriate.
* Contribute to query resolution, data cleaning, and study metrics tracking to support accurate reporting and inspection readiness.
* Support screening operations and meet enrollment expectations for assigned study tasks.
* Prepare internal reports or summaries for review under guidance from CRC II/III.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree required.
* At least 6 months of prior clinical research experience. Experience with industry-sponsored clinical trials preferred.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to multitask in a fast-paced environment.
* Willingness to continue learning hands-on clinical and research skills.

  

**Pay**: $27.00 - $33.00 per hour

* Medical, Dental &Vision insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance

* Life insurance

* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance

  

Adams Clinical is committed to being an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We focus on hiring and nurturing top talent. Founded in 1988, Robin Hood is a 501(c)(3) public charity that finds, fuels, and creates the most impactful and scalable solutions lifting New Yorkers permanently out of poverty in New York City. We convene philanthropists, civil society organizations, government, businesses, nonprofits, community members, and those living in poverty to develop and advance programs and policies that can make the American Dream real here in New York City.

  

Our investments include best-in-class organizations providing legal services, housing, meals, workforce development training, childcare, education, and other vital services that give New Yorkers the tools to build better lives. The programs it funds are often the first of their kind and serve as demonstration models to identify what works before being replicated in other cities. Because our Board of Directors covers 100% of all administrative, fundraising, and evaluation costs, every dollar donated goes directly to organizations helping New Yorkers in need.

  

While Robin Hood's primary focus is on New York, its impact extends far beyond the borders of the city. Its pioneering, metrics-based approach has become the gold standard for charities around the nation as Robin Hood works to understand and evaluate the impact of its partners to ensure that its philanthropic dollars are utilized to maximum impact. Robin Hood also supports its community partners and their leaders with financial and strategic support and management assistance that allows those organizations to maximize their impact.

  

Robin Hood also understands that if we are to support families living in poverty on the path towards financial independence, we must become an effective partner with government. We do this by collaborating with government partners to build program and policy innovations that hold the promise of expanding economic opportunity in New York City - providing nimble "risk capital" for high-potential strategies.
