Job ID: 530508

CRH's Americas Materials division is the leading integrated supplier of aggregates, asphalt, ready mixed concrete and paving and construction services in North America. Our operations span North America with over 29,000 employees at close to 1,660 locations in 45 US States and 2 Canadian provinces.

  

**Job** **Summary**

CRH Americas Materials currently has ~15 different ERP systems (from two separate software vendors - SAP and Viewpoint) and is on a transformational journey, named Project Phoenix, to move to a single ERP environment (SAP) with standardized business processes across the company. This will be a multi-year program with complex change management and implementation plans. The transformation includes the integration or retirement of a full suite of approximately 30 legacy applications spanning finance, operations, safety, HR, environmental, and other functional areas as those business processes move onto SAP S/4HANA.

The Executive Assistant, Event & Logistics Lead plans and supports in-person events for Project Phoenix. Reporting to the VP, Assistant GM, Phoenix Deployment for the project, this role coordinates logistics for training, testing and validation meetings held in multiple waves across multiple locations in the US and Canada. The role will also support the Phoenix team with administrative needs between events.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, budget conscious and comfortable managing large groups, multiple vendors and last-minute changes. Exceptional attention to detail is critical to success in this role.

This is a project-based role with travel of 50% or more.

.

**Job Responsibilities**

Event Planning & Logistics

  

* Plan and coordinate in person events from start to finish, including training, testing and validation sessions.
* Source and manage hotels, venues, catering, AV and other vendors, and coordinate contract review and approval.
* Manage hotel room blocks, meeting space and event materials such as name badges, signage and supplies.
* Provide onsite support during events, including setup, check in and issue resolution.
* Partner with IT and AV teams to make sure technology is ready for each event.

Attendee Management & Communications

  

* Maintain accurate attendee lists and manage registration, confirmations and follow up.
* Partner with Business Unit leaders to confirm attendee lists and coordinate changes.
* Draft and send attendee communications, including invitations, logistics details, agendas and reminders.

Budget & Administration

  

* Track event spending against budget and look for ways to reduce costs.
* Review and process vendor invoices and expenses accurately and on time.

Project Phoenix Team Support

  

* Support the Project Phoenix team with administrative needs.
* Manage calendars and schedule meetings and calls, including recurring team meetings and calls with Business Unit leaders and consulting partners.
* Arrange team meals, catering and working lunches as needed.
* Work with other assistants across CRH to coordinate schedules, meetings and events.
* Complete other duties as assigned.

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Identify and plan all business activities for each value stream related to technical cutover for assigned deployment waves.

**About the Role:**

The Logistics Coordinator plays a critical role in ensuring the efficient and timely movement of goods throughout the warehouse. This position is responsible for coordinating all aspects of logistics operations, including inventory management, warehousing, shipping, and receiving activities. The successful candidate will work closely with suppliers, carriers, and internal teams to optimize transportation routes and warehouse utilization, minimizing costs while maintaining high service levels. They will also monitor shipment schedules, resolve any logistical issues, and ensure compliance with regulatory requirements. Ultimately, the Logistics Coordinator ensures that products are delivered accurately and on time, supporting overall business objectives and customer satisfaction.

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or equivalent; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain management, or related field preferred.
* Proven experience in logistics coordination, warehouse management, or a similar role.
* Strong knowledge of shipping and receiving procedures and regulations within the United States.
* Proficiency with logistics software and inventory management systems.
* Excellent organizational and communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certification in logistics or supply chain management (e.g., APICS, CSCMP).
* Experience with transportation management systems (TMS) and warehouse management systems (WMS).
* Familiarity with customs regulations and international shipping processes.
* Ability to analyze data to improve logistics processes and reduce costs.
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment.

**Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and monitor the entire order cycle to enhance business development and ensure customer satisfaction.
* Manage warehouse operations including inventory control, stock replenishment, and space optimization.
* Schedule and track shipments, liaising with carriers and freight companies to ensure timely delivery.
* Maintain accurate records of shipping and receiving activities, including documentation and compliance with regulations.
* Identify and resolve logistical problems, such as delays or discrepancies, proactively communicating with relevant stakeholders.

**Skills:**

The required skills in logistics management, warehouse management, warehousing, and shipping and receiving are applied daily to coordinate and streamline the flow of goods from suppliers to customers. The Logistics Coordinator uses logistics management skills to plan and execute transportation strategies that reduce costs and improve delivery times. Warehouse management and warehousing skills are essential for maintaining accurate inventory levels, organizing storage space efficiently, and ensuring smooth receiving and dispatching operations. Shipping and receiving expertise enables the coordinator to handle documentation, compliance, and communication with carriers effectively. Preferred skills such as proficiency with logistics software and certifications enhance the ability to analyze data, optimize processes, and adapt to evolving supply chain challenges.

Cohorts begin every week and are limited to 25 Residents. Apply early to be considered for the next available start date.

**Day 100** — Transfer to the partner. Successful Residents transfer directly onto the partner's payroll at the compensation above, with full benefits starting that day.

Led by CEO Michael Colonnese, a 15+ year veteran of workforce development focused on building debt-free pathways into tech careers.

Our partners pay us. You don't. That's the entire business model.

**Who Tends to Succeed Here**

No prior sales experience required. We hire people who are:

* Competitive and motivated by clear goals

If you've worked in retail, hospitality, customer service, fundraising, fitness instruction, teaching, or any role where you spent your day talking to people and meeting goals — you already have the foundation to be excellent at this.

* Cohort placement. If you move forward, we'll match you with a partner company and a start date. Cohorts begin every Monday and are limited to 25 Residents — apply early for priority consideration.

**Apply today.** The next cohort starts soon and spots fill on a first-reviewed basis.

### **Preferred Qualifications:**

new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative III, Health Systems- U4B Health
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
At Uber Health, we are transforming access to healthcare by simplifying patient transportation and care access for organizations across the U.S.  
  
As a Business Development Representative (BDR) supporting our Health Systems segment, you will play a key role in driving growth across a defined set of strategic health system accounts. This is not a pure “white space” role — you will focus on account-based outbound, leveraging partnership channels and targeted outreach to build pipeline and accelerate adoption of Uber Health’s transportation solutions.  
  
You’ll work closely with Account Executives and cross-functional teams to deliver a seamless experience from initial engagement through onboarding.  
  
This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a high-impact, collaborative, and strategic sales environment  
  
**Key Responsibilities**  
  
**Strategic Prospecting & Account Engagement**  

* Execute targeted outbound campaigns across a defined set of health system accounts via email, phone, and LinkedIn
* Identify and engage key stakeholders across clinical, operational, and procurement teams
* Leverage partnership-driven entry points and account insights to drive meaningful conversations

  
**Pipeline Development & Qualification**  

* Conduct discovery calls via Zoom to understand customer needs and align Uber Health transportation solutions to use cases (e.g., reducing no-shows, improving discharge efficiency, increasing access to care)
* Qualify opportunities and build a strong, high-quality pipeline within assigned accounts
* Partner with Account Executives to prioritize and penetrate high-value organizations

  
**Onboarding Support & Customer Experience**  

* Support light onboarding efforts, including initial setup guidance and early-stage troubleshooting
* Ensure a seamless, “white glove” handoff of qualified opportunities to Account Executives

  
**Cross-Functional Collaboration**  

* Work closely with AEs, Account Managers, and Customer Support to deliver a cohesive customer experience
* Align on account strategies, outreach plans, and pipeline goals

  
**Pipeline & Reporting**  

* Maintain accurate activity tracking and pipeline management within CRM tools
* Consistently meet or exceed outbound activity and pipeline generation targets

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* 1+ year of sales, business development, or related experience
* Experience engaging with health systems, enterprise organizations, or public sector customers
* Familiarity with outbound prospecting tools (ZoomInfo, Salesloft/Groove, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, etc.)
* Strong communication and organizational skills
* Ability to operate in a fast-paced, evolving environment

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Experience working within healthcare or selling into health systems / IDNs
* Familiarity with GPOs, partnership-driven sales motions, or enterprise procurement processes
* Experience prospecting into large, decentralized organizations
* Understanding of healthcare transportation workflows (e.g., patient transport, discharge planning, access to care)
* Demonstrated ability to build pipeline within a defined account list

  
For Chicago, IL-based roles: The total on-target earnings (OTE) range for this position is USD $89,286 - USD $99,286. The OTE includes a base salary range of USD $62,500 per year - USD $69,500 per year and an annualized cash variable incentive target of USD $26,786 - USD $29,786.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The total on-target earnings (OTE) range for this position is USD $99,286 - USD $110,000. The OTE includes a base salary range of USD $69,500 per year - USD $77,000 per year and an annualized cash variable incentive target of USD $29,786 - USD $33,000.  
  
The cash variable incentive target is based on individual sales performance and its payment is based on the terms of the Sales Incentive Plan.  
  
An equity award and other forms of compensation may be included in the offer. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.  
  
Offices remain key to collaboration and Uber's culture. Unless approved for full remote work, employees must spend at least 50% of their time in-office. Some roles, like those at greenlight hubs, require full-time in-office presence. Ask your Recruiter for details about this role's requirements.  
  
Uber is proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. **Retail Sales Representative**

**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**Full-Time Retail Sales Representative**

**T-Mobile Premium Retailer—TCC Wireless**

**Make up to $20+/hour all in!**

**Base pay and commission!**

The retail sales representative enjoys a fast-paced and high-energy environment. As a retail sales representative, you are the connection between the customer and the T-Mobile brand. You are fun, energetic, and fierce about the wireless industry and knowing your gear inside and out—from the latest phones to the most competitive pricing plans. As a member of the TCC Wireless family, you have a passion for creating long-lasting relationships and meaningful connections with not only your customers but your business colleagues as well.

Must be able to perform the essential functions of the position with or without reasonable accommodation.

* Professional, energetic, honest, patient, and empathetic

new_jobs.description:
**Position Purpose:**  
The Legal Operations Coordinator maintains the corporate records for the health system, manages the Legal Department’s contract database, prepares reports and analyses on key performance indicators, assists with governance matters including preparation of minutes, and the logistics of board meetings and board committee meetings, provides operational support to the Legal department and assists with risk management and insurance functions. This position reports to General Counsel.

  

**Key Job Activities:**

* Responsible for the maintenance of corporate records, including but not limited to the Illinois Secretary of State's reporting, review and storing of records from government entities, corporate licensure documents, and the like.
* Sources, evaluates, implements, and trains staff on the contract database and other software programs used by the Legal department.
* Assist with management of the legal department’s budget and dashboard and regularly updates and monitors the budget to help control costs.
* Assists with the development, implementation, and oversight of the contract management program.
* Assist with the handling of all bills and invoices for the legal and risk department.
* Responsible for preparing minutes, board meeting and board committee meeting packets, and assisting the Board on a variety of scheduling and other issues.
* Handles requests for all certificates of insurance and assists with the monitoring of non-professional liability claims.
* Assists with the development of best-in-class systems, policies, and processes required for maximum efficiency and consistency across the department.
* Assists with new hire onboarding and onboarding of legal interns.
* Completes ad hoc and special projects as requested/required by the General Counsel and Associate General Counsel.
* Provides administrative support for the Legal and Risk Department.
* Works with outside counsel on deposition and other discovery matters.
* Performs other duties as assigned.

  

**Education and Work Experience:**

Associate degree required

Paralegal Certification required  
Minimum of 3 years of in-house legal experience  
Demonstrated contract management experience preferred  
Paralegal experience, ideally within the healthcare setting

**Knowledge and Skills:**

* Knowledge and demonstrable experience implementing and managing core legal systems, such as MediTract.
* Ability to manage a fast-paced legal department’s operational needs.
* Understanding of intermediate finance concepts and processes, gained through education or experience.
* Mastery of Microsoft applications.
* Ability to simultaneously drive multiple projects and identify, prioritize and resolve key business issues.
* Works independently as well as under general instructions.
* Expected to determine how to accomplish the work assignments.
* This position will be privy to highly confidential information and will have responsibilities that require direct contact with internal and external clients.
* Assists the General Counsel in department operations management.
* Experience in EPIC and MEDITECH software systems preferred.

  
Location: SHS · SHS SHS ADMINISTRATION
